By adiabatically eliminating the cavity and resonantly driving the qubit, an effective magnon-qubit conditional-displacement interaction is achieved. Further working in the magnon-magnon strong-coupling regime and considering two identical magnon frequencies and coupling strengths to the cavity, two hybridized magnon modes are formed, of which the bright mode is prepared in a cat state after a projective measurement on the qubit, while the dark mode remains in its initial vacuum state. Such a state corresponds to a two-mode cat state of two original magnon modes, which share strong non-Gaussian entanglement. We also discuss practical dissipation and dephasing effects on the cat state. The results indicate that strong nonclassicality and non-Gaussian entanglement are present in the two-mode cat state using fully feasible parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose to prepare、adiabatically eliminating、projective measurement、discuss effects。；研究对象：腔-磁振子-量子比特系统中的双模磁振子薛定谔猫态（非高斯纠缠态），具体涉及两个钇铁石榴石（YIG）球体和一个超导量子比特耦合到同一微波腔。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过绝热消除腔模并共振驱动量子比特，可实现有效的磁振子-量子比特条件位移相互作用；在磁振子-磁振子强耦合条件下，对量子比特进行投影测量后，可将亮模制备成猫态，从而得到两个原始磁振子模式的双模猫态，该态具有强非高斯纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过绝热消除腔模并共振驱动量子比特，可实现有效的磁振子-量子比特条件位移相互作用；在磁振子-磁振子强耦合条件下，对量子比特进行投影测量后，可将亮模制备成猫态，从而得到两个原始磁振子模式的双模猫态，该态具有强非高斯纠缠。；创新点：在腔-磁振子-量子比特平台上提出制备双模磁振子猫态（非高斯纠缠态）的方案，并利用完全可行的参数验证了强非经典性和非高斯纠缠的存在。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：绝热消除腔模、共振驱动量子比特实现有效相互作用；利用磁振子-磁振子强耦合形成杂化模式（亮模和暗模）；通过投影测量制备猫态；并考虑了实际耗散和退相干效应。

papers.title: Wide-field NV magnetometry under simultaneous high-pressure and high-temperature conditions
papers.abstract: We demonstrate wide-field optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) under simultaneous high-pressure and high-temperature conditions using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers. Although NV-center magnetometry has been widely used for spatially resolved magnetic-field imaging, its application to extreme environments combining pressure and temperature remains challenging. In this work, we show that ODMR can be observed at 5 GPa and 500 K, demonstrating the feasibility of NV spin readout under such combined extreme conditions. We further perform wide-field ODMR of iron at 7 GPa and 500 K, where the stray magnetic field from the sample is spatially visualized through the pressure cell. These results establish NV-center magnetometry as a promising platform for imaging magnetic phenomena in materials under high-pressure and high-temperature environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、observed、performed、wide-field ODMR。；研究对象：氮空位（NV）中心在同时高压（5-7 GPa）和高温（500 K）极端条件下的磁学成像应用，以及铁样品在高压高温下的杂散磁场成像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在5 GPa和500 K的联合极端条件下成功观测到NV中心的光探测磁共振（ODMR）信号，证明NV自旋读出在此类极端环境中的可行性；并在7 GPa和500 K下实现了对铁样品杂散磁场的宽场成像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在5 GPa和500 K的联合极端条件下成功观测到NV中心的光探测磁共振（ODMR）信号，证明NV自旋读出在此类极端环境中的可行性；并在7 GPa和500 K下实现了对铁样品杂散磁场的宽场成像。；创新点：首次在同时施加高压（5 GPa）和高温（500 K）的联合极端条件下实现宽场NV磁力测量，突破了此前NV磁力测量难以应用于压力-温度复合极端环境的限制。
papers.method_zh: 宽场光探测磁共振（wide-field ODMR）技术，结合金刚石对顶砧（pressure cell）实现高压高温环境，利用NV中心作为量子传感器进行空间分辨的磁场成像。

papers.title: A convolutional neural network surrogate for hierarchical homogenization: fast elastic moduli prediction of digital rocks
papers.abstract: Digital rock physics (DRP) aims to estimate effective rock properties (e.g., elastic moduli) directly from 3D micro-CT images. However, direct numerical simulations (DNS) on high-resolution large 3D scans are often computationally prohibitive and severely limit the application of DRP. To address this bottleneck, we combine a lightweight 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) with hierarchical homogenization (HHM) and apply it to determine effective elastic moduli. In this scheme, a large rock image is divided into subcubes. The CNN replaces costly DNS by directly predicting subcube elastic moduli, while HHM upscales subcube-level predictions to the full rock. Using a shared convolutional backbone, we systematically compare three training targets: (i) full anisotropic $6\times6$ stiffness tensors, (ii) isotropic bulk and shear moduli $(K, G)$, and (iii) Hashin--Shtrikman (HS)-normalized factors. Across multiple rock types, all three models agree well with DNS results while substantially reducing the computational cost. Moreover, training from scratch on each rock type is fast enough that transfer learning is unnecessary. Across all three targets, the accuracy is comparable. In our comparative study, the HS-normalized factor offers the best overall speed--accuracy trade-off while guaranteeing physical consistency, making it a convenient default. The isotropic $(K, G)$ target is a slightly more accurate alternative.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：convolutional neural network、hierarchical homogenization、direct numerical simulations、predicting elastic moduli。；研究对象：数字岩石（digital rocks）的有效弹性模量（elastic moduli），具体通过3D微CT图像（micro-CT images）进行预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）与层次均匀化方法（HHM），能够以极低的计算成本准确预测数字岩石的有效弹性模量，且三种训练目标（全各向异性刚度张量、各向同性体积模量与剪切模量、Hashin-Shtrikman归一化因子）的预测精度相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结合轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）与层次均匀化方法（HHM），能够以极低的计算成本准确预测数字岩石的有效弹性模量，且三种训练目标（全各向异性刚度张量、各向同性体积模量与剪切模量、Hashin-Shtrikman归一化因子）的预测精度相当。；创新点：提出了一种将轻量级CNN与层次均匀化相结合的高效代理模型，显著降低了数字岩石物理中高分辨率大尺寸3D图像直接数值模拟的计算瓶颈；并系统比较了三种不同训练目标的性能，发现HS归一化因子在保证物理一致性的同时提供了最佳的速度-精度权衡。摘要未突出说明相对于已有CNN代理模型的具体架构或训练策略改进。
papers.method_zh: 采用轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）替代直接数值模拟（DNS），将大尺寸岩石图像划分为子立方体，CNN预测子立方体的弹性模量，再通过层次均匀化（HHM）将子立方体级别的预测结果上尺度至整个岩石。系统比较了三种训练目标：全各向异性6×6刚度张量、各向同性体积模量与剪切模量(K, G)、以及Hashin-Shtrikman (HS)归一化因子。

papers.title: Nonlocal Quantum Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Phase transitions are paradigmatic examples of emergent phenomena, in which symmetries present at the microscopic level can be spontaneously broken in the thermodynamic limit. Two primary physical mechanisms can drive this symmetry breaking: thermal fluctuations in classical phase transitions and quantum fluctuations in quantum critical phenomena. Here, we introduce $nonlocal$ $quantum$ $fluctuations$ as a new fundamental mechanism to drive phase transitions. We show that entanglement shared between environmental modes can induce a correlated symmetry breaking in remote systems, independent of their spatial separation. Using the framework of driven-dissipative phase transitions, we theoretically investigate a system composed of two nonlinear quantum resonators placed at arbitrarily large spatial separations, each coupled to independent local Markovian baths. We consider the regime in which remote environmental modes are prepared in broadband entangled states. We show that near the critical point, where the susceptibility to weak perturbations diverges, quantum correlations in the environments govern the system critical behavior. While these correlations manifest locally only as effective thermal fluctuations, at the global level they give rise to an emergent nonlocal phase transition, marked by the spontaneous symmetry breaking of a collective mode shared by the two remote systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically investigate”“framework of driven-dissipative phase transitions”等表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非局域量子相变，具体体系为两个空间上远距离分离的非线性量子谐振子，各自耦合到独立局域马尔可夫热库，且远程环境模式制备在宽带纠缠态中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“非局域量子涨落”作为驱动相变的新机制：环境模式之间共享的纠缠可以在远程系统之间诱导关联对称性破缺，且不依赖于空间距离；在临界点附近，环境中的量子关联主导系统临界行为，导致全局非局域相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“非局域量子涨落”作为驱动相变的新机制：环境模式之间共享的纠缠可以在远程系统之间诱导关联对称性破缺，且不依赖于空间距离；在临界点附近，环境中的量子关联主导系统临界行为，导致全局非局域相变。；创新点：首次将“非局域量子涨落”确立为驱动相变的基本机制，区别于传统的热涨落和量子涨落；揭示了环境纠缠在远程系统间诱导集体模式自发对称性破缺的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用驱动-耗散相变理论框架，分析两个非线性量子谐振子分别与独立局域马尔可夫热库耦合的系统，并假设远程环境模式处于宽带纠缠态。

papers.title: A Contactless Heat Engine Driven by Nonreciprocal Fluctuation-Induced Torques
papers.abstract: We describe a contactless heat engine in which quantum and thermal electromagnetic fluctuations act as the working medium. The setup consists of two concentric cylinders held at different temperatures. The inner cylinder stably levitates within the outer one due to repulsive nonequilibrium Casimir forces. The chirality of the setup is broken by using nonreciprocal dielectric materials, akin to application of a magnetic field along the common cylinder axis. Using Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics, we show that heat transfer and torque can be expressed in terms of an angular-momentum-resolved heat flux density, $Φ_n(ω)$: each exchanged photon carries energy $\hbar ω$ and angular momentum $\hbar n$. In reciprocal media contributions from modes $n$ and $-n$ cancel and there is no net torque; nonreciprocity breaks this symmetry and powers rotation of the inner cylinder. Even in the absence of contact, electromagnetic fluctuations produce a frictional torque opposing rotation that we compute. This enables computation of characteristic steady state rotations, and estimation of the engine efficiency (which remains bounded by the Carnot limit). The cylindrical setup provides a natural realization of fluctuation-induced angular-momentum transfer and a possible route toward nanoscale contactless engines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：描述、展示、计算、理论框架（Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics）。；研究对象：一种非接触式热机，其工作介质为量子与热电磁涨落，具体体系为两个同心圆柱体，内圆柱在非平衡卡西米尔力作用下稳定悬浮于外圆柱内，并利用非互易介电材料打破手性对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非互易介质中，光子携带的角动量模式n与-n的贡献不再抵消，从而产生净扭矩驱动内圆柱旋转；同时电磁涨落会产生摩擦扭矩，两者共同决定稳态转速，该热机效率受卡诺极限约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非互易介质中，光子携带的角动量模式n与-n的贡献不再抵消，从而产生净扭矩驱动内圆柱旋转；同时电磁涨落会产生摩擦扭矩，两者共同决定稳态转速，该热机效率受卡诺极限约束。；创新点：首次提出利用非互易电磁涨落诱导的扭矩实现非接触式热机，并建立了角动量分辨的热流理论框架，为纳米尺度非接触引擎提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用Rytov涨落电动力学理论，将热传递和扭矩表达为角动量分辨的热流密度Φ_n(ω)，分析每个交换光子携带的能量ħω和角动量ħn，并计算非互易性导致的对称性破缺及摩擦扭矩。

papers.title: Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes and duality webs of fermionic topological phases
papers.abstract: Stabilizer codes provide exact lattice realizations of bosonic topological orders. In contrast, systematic stabilizer descriptions of intrinsically fermionic topological phases remain much less developed. In this work, we introduce Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes, a class of exactly solvable fermionic lattice models whose stabilizers are built from both generalized Pauli operators and Majorana operators. As a main example, we construct an exactly solvable stabilizer realization of the fermionic toric code: an intrinsically fermionic $\mathbb Z_2$ topological order in $(2{+}1)$ dimensions, using $\mathbb Z_8$ Pauli operators coupled to Majorana modes. Within this stabilizer framework, the anyons, string operators, fusion rules, and braiding statistics all follow naturally from the stabilizer algebra. More broadly, we show that the fermionic toric code belongs to a duality web generated by anyon condensation and by gauging bosonic or fermion-parity symmetries. This web connects bosonic topological orders, symmetry-enriched topological phases, and both bosonic and fermionic symmetry-protected topological phases, all within a common stabilizer description. We further show that the construction extends to all Abelian fermionic topological orders with gapped boundaries and to all supercohomology fermionic SPT phases in $(2{+}1)$ dimensions. Going beyond Majorana operators, we introduce fermionic versions of the clock and shift operators and use them to construct an exact bosonization map for $\mathbb Z_D^F$ symmetries for $D$ even. Using this, we realize a stabilizer model for a nontrivial $\mathbb Z_8^F$ fermionic SPT phase with no free-fermion analog. Altogether, these results extend the stabilizer-code paradigm to a broad class of intrinsically fermionic phases bridging fermionic quantum many-body physics to quantum error correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stabilizer codes、exactly solvable models、topological phases、duality webs、bosonization map。；研究对象：本征费米子拓扑相，特别是(2+1)维费米子toric code（一种本征费米子Z₂拓扑序），以及更广泛的阿贝尔费米子拓扑序和超上同调费米子SPT相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes，首次实现了对(2+1)维本征费米子toric code的精确可解stabilizer模型，并证明该模型属于一个由任意子凝聚和规范对称性（玻色子或费米子宇称）生成的duality web，将玻色子拓扑序、对称性 enriched 拓扑相以及玻色/费米子SPT相统一在共同的stabilizer描述中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes，首次实现了对(2+1)维本征费米子toric code的精确可解stabilizer模型，并证明该模型属于一个由任意子凝聚和规范对称性（玻色子或费米子宇称）生成的duality web，将玻色子拓扑序、对称性 enriched 拓扑相以及玻色/费米子SPT相统一在共同的stabilizer描述中。；创新点：将stabilizer code范式系统性地扩展到本征费米子拓扑相，提供了首个精确可解的stabilizer实现（费米子toric code），并揭示了其与玻色子拓扑序、SPT相之间的duality web。此外，通过构造费米子clock and shift算符，实现了对Z_D^F对称性的精确玻色化，并构建了无自由费米子类比的本征Z₈费米子SPT相的stabilizer模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于广义Pauli算符和Majorana算符构建Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes；利用Z₈ Pauli算符耦合Majorana模式构造费米子toric code的stabilizer模型；通过stabilizer代数推导任意子、弦算符、融合规则和编织统计；引入费米子版本的clock and shift算符，构建Z_D^F对称性的精确玻色化映射。

papers.title: Localization region detection with directionality estimation in a two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattice model
papers.abstract: This work is devoted to data-driven identification of discrete breathers in numerical simulations of a two-dimensional crystal lattice using locally sampled wave data. Different lattice wave datasets are considered, with data collected from regions of different shapes and sizes defined by the lattice particles in mechanical equilibrium. Specifically, in addition to regions with a regular hexagonal shape, one- and quasi-one-dimensional regions reflecting the quasi-one-dimensionality of discrete breathers in two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattices are proposed. To improve numerical efficiency, dataset dimensionality is reduced using Principal Component Analysis, and highly accurate Support Vector Machine classifiers are trained to distinguish between linear and nonlinear wave data. The obtained classifiers, together with the sliding window method, are applied to detect localization regions in two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattice numerical simulations. High-precision algorithms for detected localization region segmentation and localized wave directionality estimation within the detected regions are further proposed, and their performance is evaluated. The presented methods are successfully applied to detect localized waves and their collision regions, as well as their directionality, performing a numerical study of stationary and traveling two-dimensional discrete breather interactions. Qualitatively better results are obtained when considering wave-data collection regions respecting the quasi-one-dimensional nature of two-dimensional discrete breathers in the hexagonal crystal lattice model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“data-driven identification”、“numerical simulations”、“Support Vector Machine classifiers”、“Principal Component Analysis”。；研究对象：二维六角晶格模型中的离散呼吸子（discrete breathers）及其局域化区域检测与方向性估计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于局部采样波数据、结合主成分分析与支持向量机分类器的数据驱动方法，能够高精度地检测二维六角晶格数值模拟中的离散呼吸子局域化区域，并进一步估计局域波的方向性，成功应用于静止与运动离散呼吸子及其碰撞区域的识别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于局部采样波数据、结合主成分分析与支持向量机分类器的数据驱动方法，能够高精度地检测二维六角晶格数值模拟中的离散呼吸子局域化区域，并进一步估计局域波的方向性，成功应用于静止与运动离散呼吸子及其碰撞区域的识别。；创新点：针对二维六角晶格中离散呼吸子的准一维特性，提出了采用一维及准一维形状的波数据采集区域，相较于传统规则六边形区域，获得了定性更好的检测结果。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用主成分分析（PCA）降低数据集维度，训练高精度支持向量机（SVM）分类器区分线性与非线性波数据；结合滑动窗口方法检测局域化区域；提出高精度区域分割与局域波方向性估计算法。

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Quantum Optimization of Defect Configurations in Doped ZrO2: XY-Mixer QAOA and Grover Adaptive Search
papers.abstract: Quantum optimization offers a route to searching the large defect-configuration spaces that arise in materials design. We develop an end-to-end, constraint-aware quantum optimization workflow for composition-defect search in a doped ZrO2 thermal-barrier-coating (TBC) material system, using a MACE-MPA-0 energy dataset to fit a 24-variable QUBO over 8 cation-occupation and 16 oxygen-vacancy variables with exactly two rare-earth substitutions and one oxygen vacancy, yielding 448 feasible configurations. The QUBO surrogate reproduces the MACE energies with held-out R2 = 0.997 (full-data R2 = 0.999, RMSE = 17 meV). We validate two complementary quantum pathways against exact enumeration: a constraint-preserving XY-mixer QAOA that confines sampling to the feasible subspace and places 86% of probability mass within 1 meV of the MACE optimum at depth p = 3, and a fault-tolerant constrained Grover Adaptive Search oracle with explicit fixed-point arithmetic, branch-safe comparison, feasibility checking, and phase kickback. Across threshold cases, the validated oracle uses 324 high-level logical qubits, or 352 to 358 with conservative clean-ancilla v-chain accounting, and requires 3.6 to 4.3 x 104 Toffoli gates per Grover (GAS) iteration. An idealized feasible-space amplification estimate suggests up to a 240x reduction in total Toffoli cost relative to the full 224 occupation space, providing a resource-estimation bridge between materials-informed QUBO modeling, constraint-aware QAOA, and fault-tolerant threshold search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum optimization、QUBO、QAOA、Grover Adaptive Search、resource estimation。；研究对象：掺杂ZrO₂热障涂层材料体系中的缺陷构型，具体为8个阳离子占位和16个氧空位变量，约束条件为恰好两个稀土元素取代和一个氧空位，共448种可行构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过约束感知的量子优化流程（XY-mixer QAOA和Grover自适应搜索），可在掺杂ZrO₂的缺陷构型空间中高效搜索，其中XY-mixer QAOA在深度p=3时能将86%的概率质量集中在MACE最优能量1 meV以内；Grover自适应搜索的容错量子线路估计需要约324-358个逻辑量子比特和每轮3.6-4.3×10⁴个Toffoli门。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过约束感知的量子优化流程（XY-mixer QAOA和Grover自适应搜索），可在掺杂ZrO₂的缺陷构型空间中高效搜索，其中XY-mixer QAOA在深度p=3时能将86%的概率质量集中在MACE最优能量1 meV以内；Grover自适应搜索的容错量子线路估计需要约324-358个逻辑量子比特和每轮3.6-4.3×10⁴个Toffoli门。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用MACE-MPA-0能量数据集拟合24变量QUBO模型（8个阳离子占位+16个氧空位），QUBO代理模型在保留测试集上R²=0.997（全数据R²=0.999，RMSE=17 meV）。验证两种量子路径：约束保持的XY-mixer QAOA（限制采样在可行子空间内）和容错约束Grover自适应搜索（含显式定点算术、分支安全比较、可行性检查和相位反冲）。

papers.title: Universality beyond the Kibble-Zurek mechanism in the condensation of coherently coupled Bose gases
papers.abstract: We study the universal spatial statistics of point-like topological defects formed during the nonequilibrium condensation of a coherently coupled Bose gas using the stochastic projected Gross-Pitaevskii equation. The symmetry-breaking transition is driven by a linear quench of the chemical potential, leading to stochastic vortex nucleation in the individual condensate components. When the two components are considered together, these elementary defects may combine across components to emerge as composite topological defects known as full quantum vortices. Beyond the mean defect density predicted by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM), we investigate the spatial organization of both the elementary and composite defects and show that their positions are well described by a Poisson point process, revealing a universal stochastic geometry. This universality is further described through Voronoi tessellation, whose cell-area statistics follow Poisson-Voronoi predictions. We also introduce the spatial form factor for characterizing the vortex configurations and demonstrate the emergence of a characteristic dip-ramp-plateau structure. Our results establish universal stochastic geometry of topological defects beyond conventional Kibble-Zurek scaling and identify it as a fundamental feature of nonequilibrium condensation in coherently coupled Bose gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用随机投影Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行数值模拟，并分析统计模型（Poisson点过程、Voronoi图）。；研究对象：相干耦合玻色气体在非平衡凝聚过程中形成的拓扑缺陷（包括基本涡旋和复合全量子涡旋）的空间统计特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在化学势线性淬火驱动的对称性破缺相变中，基本涡旋和复合涡旋的空间分布均服从泊松点过程，其Voronoi胞元面积统计符合泊松-沃罗诺伊预测，揭示了超越Kibble-Zurek机制（KZM）平均缺陷密度的普适随机几何。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在化学势线性淬火驱动的对称性破缺相变中，基本涡旋和复合涡旋的空间分布均服从泊松点过程，其Voronoi胞元面积统计符合泊松-沃罗诺伊预测，揭示了超越Kibble-Zurek机制（KZM）平均缺陷密度的普适随机几何。；创新点：首次在相干耦合玻色气体中证明，拓扑缺陷的空间组织（而非仅平均密度）遵循普适的随机几何（泊松点过程），这超越了传统KZM仅预测平均缺陷密度的框架。摘要未突出说明与实验的对比或具体参数范围。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机投影Gross-Pitaevskii方程模拟相干耦合玻色气体的非平衡凝聚过程；通过化学势线性淬火驱动对称性破缺；使用泊松点过程、Voronoi图胞元面积统计以及空间形状因子（dip-ramp-plateau结构）分析涡旋构型。

papers.title: First-Order Recoverability Collapse in Self-Referential Information Decoders
papers.abstract: We study adaptive systems coupling inference to irreversible action under sustained nonequilibrium driving. Treating information processing as a thermodynamic load, we model them as finite-capacity decoders whose irreversible commitments eliminate counterfactual options, and characterize recoverable operation by a feasibility margin and a stability diagnostic fixing when irreversible action is admissible. Under sustained overload -- induced flux exceeding effective integrative capacity -- loss of recoverability and divergence of the diagnostic arise as structural consequences of capacity saturation, independent of optimization objective, control policy, or substrate. Added capacity alone does not restore recoverability: absent certification or gating, higher throughput accelerates non-recoverable loss, with high-throughput AI a concrete application. Making the feedback explicit -- each uncertified commitment spawning on average alpha new candidates -- turns the continuous transition first-order: lucid and collapsed states coexist in a cusp-organized bistable region with closed-form spinodals, collapse pre-empts the continuous divergence at finite stability ratio, recovery is hysteretic, and for alpha >= 1 load reduction alone cannot restore operation. Cascade sizes are bounded by the grounded fraction of input: a genealogy-times-congestion factorization sets a cutoff that grows as grounding shrinks, with the mean-field exponent tau = 3/2 recovered away from the boundary and each cascade carrying a Landauer-priced burst of synthetic entropy; event-driven simulations confirm the cutoff law and phase structure. This supplies the statistical mechanics of the metastable failures seen in distributed systems. The analysis is constraint-based and substrate-agnostic, establishing recoverable dissipation as a necessary criterion for decoder stability in high-flux regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：model（建模）、analysis（分析）、statistical mechanics（统计力学）、constraint-based（基于约束的）、substrate-agnostic（与基底无关）。；研究对象：自指信息解码器（Self-Referential Information Decoders）中的可恢复性崩溃（Recoverability Collapse）现象。具体研究在持续非平衡驱动下，将推理与不可逆行动耦合的自适应系统，将其视为有限容量的解码器，并分析其在高通量负载下的稳定性与失效机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在持续过载条件下，解码器的可恢复性丧失和稳定性诊断发散是容量饱和的结构性后果，且无法通过单纯增加容量来恢复。当反馈显式化时，该连续相变转变为一级相变，表现为清晰态与崩溃态共存的双稳态区域，恢复过程具有滞后性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在持续过载条件下，解码器的可恢复性丧失和稳定性诊断发散是容量饱和的结构性后果，且无法通过单纯增加容量来恢复。当反馈显式化时，该连续相变转变为一级相变，表现为清晰态与崩溃态共存的双稳态区域，恢复过程具有滞后性。；创新点：将信息处理系统的过载失效问题纳入统计力学框架，揭示了可恢复性崩溃作为容量饱和的结构性必然结果，而非依赖于具体优化目标或控制策略。首次将自指反馈引入模型，使失效从连续相变转变为一级相变，并给出了闭式解，揭示了滞后和双稳态等新特征。摘要未明确说明与已有具体模型（如神经网络、纠错码）的直接对比，但强调了其基底无关性。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于约束的、与基底无关的理论分析框架。将信息处理视为热力学负载，通过定义可行性裕度（feasibility margin）和稳定性诊断（stability diagnostic）来刻画可恢复操作。通过引入显式反馈（每个未经认证的承诺平均产生α个新候选者），将连续转变转化为一级相变，并推导出闭式旋节线（spinodals）。利用级联（cascade）大小的因子化分析（genealogy-times-congestion factorization）和平均场指数（mean-field exponent τ = 3/2）进行统计力学描述，并通过事件驱动模拟（event-driven simulations）验证截止定律和相结构。

papers.title: Mechanism of Band Gap Formation in Beam Networks
papers.abstract: Band gaps are commonly attributed to Bragg scattering or local resonance, yet it remains unclear whether these mechanisms govern band gap formation in beam networks. In this work, we explain band gap formation in beam networks in terms of a new mechanism, geometry-induced coupling between deformation modes. Specifically, band gap onset arises from axial-bending coupling at lattice nodes and scales with the axial cutoff frequency of a one-dimensional periodic beam, whereas band gap termination is primarily governed by high-frequency rotational branches associated with beam geometry. This mechanism holds for both periodic and disordered beam networks. In periodic lattices, it manifests through beam orientations at lattice nodes, whereas in disordered networks it manifests through short-beam statistics arising from variations in beam length. Together, these results establish a unified mechanism for band gap formation across both periodic and disordered beam networks, providing new insight into the physical origin of band gaps in beam-network materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：explain、mechanism、geometry-induced coupling、theoretical framework）；研究对象：梁网络（beam networks）中的带隙形成机制，涵盖周期性和无序梁网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 梁网络中带隙的形成源于一种新机制——几何诱导的变形模式耦合：带隙起始由晶格节点处的轴向-弯曲耦合决定，并随一维周期梁的轴向截止频率缩放；带隙终止主要由与梁几何相关的高频旋转分支控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：梁网络中带隙的形成源于一种新机制——几何诱导的变形模式耦合：带隙起始由晶格节点处的轴向-弯曲耦合决定，并随一维周期梁的轴向截止频率缩放；带隙终止主要由与梁几何相关的高频旋转分支控制。；创新点：提出并建立了统一解释周期性和无序梁网络中带隙形成的新机制，区别于传统的布拉格散射或局域共振机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于几何诱导的变形模式耦合机制，结合一维周期梁的轴向截止频率和梁几何的高频旋转分支分析，未使用具体实验或数值计算方法（摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Anyon Exchange Phase from Antidot Interferometry
papers.abstract: Quasiparticles in fractional quantum Hall systems are anyons, carrying a fraction of the electron charge. Exchanging two of them gives rise to a fractional exchange phase. While the fractional charge and the braiding phase -- twice the exchange phase -- have been measured, the exchange phase itself has remained inaccessible. We study a quantum antidot embedded in a Fabry-Perot interferometer. Within a systematic non-equilibrium Keldysh treatment that consistently includes the occupation and level broadening of the antidot, we find that the transmission phase evolves non-monotonically when a gate voltage tunes the antidot through a resonance, in contrast to the monotonic evolution for electrons. The bare exchange phase can be extracted from the difference between the phase plateaus.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“systematic non-equilibrium Keldysh treatment”，属于理论框架分析，未涉及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔系统中的任意子（anyon）及其交换相位，具体为嵌入法布里-珀罗干涉仪中的量子反点（quantum antidot）系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非平衡Keldysh理论处理，发现当栅极电压调谐反点通过共振时，透射相位呈现非单调演化（与电子的单调演化相反），并且可以从相位平台之间的差值中提取出裸交换相位。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非平衡Keldysh理论处理，发现当栅极电压调谐反点通过共振时，透射相位呈现非单调演化（与电子的单调演化相反），并且可以从相位平台之间的差值中提取出裸交换相位。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡Keldysh格林函数方法，系统考虑了反点的占据数和能级展宽。

papers.title: Exact log-odds representation and mean-field criticality of a growing social group model
papers.abstract: We present an exact analytical reformulation of a growing social group model -- a Hamiltonian-free nonequilibrium process in which a group grows by noisy, consensus-driven admission. Cast as a gradient flow on logarithmic time, the fixed-point structure collapses to a single self-consistent equation: $\arctanh(φ^*) = m \cdot \arctanh(αφ^*)$, where $φ$ is the polarization, $α=1-2η$ the evaluation reliability, and $m$ the number of evaluators. The equation has a direct log-odds interpretation: each verdict contributes log-likelihood ratio $2\arctanh(αφ)$; unanimity accumulates $m$ independent evidence pieces. The dynamics thus constitutes an exact mean-field theory of self-consistent inference, ordering when the collective gain $mα$ overcomes the dilution of growth. We develop a systematic three-layer framework: core theory (Landau-like effective potential, comparison with the mean-field Ising model, and features without equilibrium counterpart), mathematical foundations (criticality from correlated verdicts, Pólya-urn martingale convergence, and an RG-like flow with group size as scale), and complementary perspectives on irreversibility and information geometry. A frozen-$N$ Freidlin--Wentzell quasipotential yields Kramers-type escape estimates for metastable states, while Monte Carlo simulations collapse onto a parameter-free deterministic master curve on logarithmic time. Systematic comparison with the mean-field Ising model reveals shared critical exponents but a nested arctanh structure unique to growth. These results provide a detailed analytical characterization of a minimal model of growth-driven collective behavior and map which elements of the equilibrium critical toolbox -- suitably reinterpreted -- survive without a Hamiltonian.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“exact analytical reformulation”、“mean-field theory”、“Landau-like effective potential”等理论分析关键词，且无实验或计算模拟作为主要手段（Monte Carlo模拟仅用于验证）。；研究对象：一个无哈密顿量的非平衡增长社会群体模型，具体描述群体通过噪声驱动的共识机制吸纳新成员，研究其极化（polarization）动力学和临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该增长群体模型的固定点结构可简化为一个自洽方程：\(\arctanh(φ^*) = m \cdot \arctanh(αφ^*)\)，其中极化\(φ\)、评估可靠性\(α\)和评估者数量\(m\)决定了系统的有序化条件（当集体增益\(mα\)克服增长稀释时）。该模型与平均场伊辛模型共享临界指数，但具有独特的嵌套反双曲正切结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该增长群体模型的固定点结构可简化为一个自洽方程：\(\arctanh(φ^*) = m \cdot \arctanh(αφ^*)\)，其中极化\(φ\)、评估可靠性\(α\)和评估者数量\(m\)决定了系统的有序化条件（当集体增益\(mα\)克服增长稀释时）。该模型与平均场伊辛模型共享临界指数，但具有独特的嵌套反双曲正切结构。；创新点：首次对无哈密顿量的增长群体模型给出精确解析重整化，揭示了其与平均场伊辛模型共享临界指数但具有独特嵌套arctanh结构，并系统映射了平衡临界工具箱中哪些元素（经适当重新解释）在无哈密顿量系统中仍然存活。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确解析方法将模型重写为对数时间上的梯度流，推导出固定点自洽方程；构建三层理论框架：核心理论（Landau类有效势、与平均场伊辛模型比较、非平衡特征）、数学基础（相关判决的临界性、Pólya-urn鞅收敛、以群体大小为尺度的RG类流）、不可逆性与信息几何视角；使用冻结\(N\)的Freidlin-Wentzell拟势给出亚稳态的Kramers型逃逸估计；Monte Carlo模拟验证确定性主曲线。

papers.title: Optical mapping of phases and phase boundaries in nanoconfined fluids
papers.abstract: In confined space, deviations from bulk structure and properties are expected due to additional thermodynamic variables. In particular, composition variations arising from surface interactions may lead to additional phases and altered phase transitions. Here, we introduce a non-invasive method for nanoscale composition mapping in confined liquids using the surface force balance (SFB). The method extends conventional SFB analysis from apex measurements to spatially resolved reconstruction of refractive index profiles within confined fluids. When multiple phases are present, the refractive index profiles provide direct access to the position and geometry of the nanoconfined fluid interfaces. We describe the interferogram analysis in detail and establish its range of validity through two model scenarios. First, measurements in air demonstrate the precision of the method and allow detection of a nanometric wetting capillary. Second, we analyse dynamic evaporation of a confined heptane droplet down to 0.1 pL volume. The method provides a time-resolved reconstruction of the meniscus geometry throughout the evaporation process. Although evaporation continuously drives the system out of equilibrium, the meniscus remains well described by a catenoidal geometry down to heights of approximately 80 nm. At smaller separations, systematic deviations from the catenoidal profile emerge, indicating a crossover from a surface tension-dominated regime to a confinement-dominated regime. Overall, we demonstrate composition profiling as a framework to analyse confinement-induced composition variations and to quantify interfacial thermodynamic effects at the nanoscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用表面力平衡（SFB）装置进行测量，并详细介绍了干涉图分析、模型实验（空气测量、庚烷液滴蒸发）等实验手段。；研究对象：纳米受限流体中的相与相界。具体体系包括：受限空气（用于方法验证）以及受限庚烷液滴的蒸发过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于表面力平衡的非侵入性光学方法，能够对纳米受限流体进行空间分辨的折射率分布成像，从而直接定位和重构多相界面。在庚烷液滴蒸发过程中，发现弯月面在高度约80 nm以上时仍符合悬链线几何，但在更小间距下出现系统偏差，表明从表面张力主导到受限效应主导的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于表面力平衡的非侵入性光学方法，能够对纳米受限流体进行空间分辨的折射率分布成像，从而直接定位和重构多相界面。在庚烷液滴蒸发过程中，发现弯月面在高度约80 nm以上时仍符合悬链线几何，但在更小间距下出现系统偏差，表明从表面张力主导到受限效应主导的交叉。；创新点：将传统SFB的顶点测量扩展为空间分辨的折射率成像，实现了对纳米受限流体中相界位置和几何形状的直接、非侵入式光学映射，并首次在动态蒸发过程中定量揭示了从表面张力主导到受限主导的交叉行为。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：表面力平衡（SFB）装置，结合干涉图分析，实现从传统顶点测量扩展到空间分辨的折射率剖面重构。通过两个模型场景（空气测量和庚烷液滴动态蒸发）验证方法的精度和适用范围。

papers.title: THz-induced phonon mode mixing and collective dynamics in a polar nanolattice
papers.abstract: Manipulating phonons through symmetry is a fundamental approach to alter the dynamic responses of materials. Most often new phases are sought through control of the unit-cell (e.g. via strain, doping, light, etc.). By comparison, there is vast potential to look beyond the unit-cell into higher-order architectures to control wave scattering and interference effects that remains less explored. We describe the THz-induced dynamics of an SrTiO$_{3}$ thin film with a nanoscale ordered interfacial dislocation network probed with 2- and 3-dimensional time-resolved x-ray diffraction and classical molecular dynamics simulations. We find that symmetry breaking at all scales is an effective approach to create a dynamical electric polarization and to control phonon mixing that generates previously unreported collective modes in the THz regime with circular vortex-like displacements. This work opens a new pathway to explore dynamical functional properties that can be extended to magnetic, electric, and ferroelectric systems by controlling the real-space topology via epitaxy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。依据：摘要中提及“2- and 3-dimensional time-resolved x-ray diffraction”（实验手段）和“classical molecular dynamics simulations”（计算方法）。；研究对象：SrTiO₃薄膜中的纳米尺度有序界面位错网络，以及太赫兹（THz）光场诱导的声子动力学和集体激发模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在所有尺度上打破对称性，可以产生动态电极化，并控制声子混合，从而在太赫兹频段生成具有环形涡旋状位移的、此前未报道过的集体模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在所有尺度上打破对称性，可以产生动态电极化，并控制声子混合，从而在太赫兹频段生成具有环形涡旋状位移的、此前未报道过的集体模式。；创新点：超越传统单胞尺度（如应变、掺杂、光照）的对称性调控，利用纳米尺度有序界面位错网络这一高阶架构来控制声子散射和干涉效应，从而发现新的太赫兹集体模式。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 二维和三维时间分辨X射线衍射（实验），以及经典分子动力学模拟（计算）。

papers.title: Introduction to matrix-product states and tensor networks
papers.abstract: These notes provide an introduction to tensor-network methods in quantum many-body physics, with an emphasis on matrix-product states (MPS). They develop the basic tensor-network language, including graphical notation, virtual indices, bond dimensions, gauge freedom, canonical forms, QR and singular-value decompositions, and the role of entanglement in controlling the efficiency of the representation. The main MPS algorithms are then introduced, including contractions, correlation functions, matrix-product operators, DMRG, and time-evolution methods. The notes also briefly discuss projected entangled-pair states (PEPS) as a higher-dimensional generalization of MPS, together with the basic ideas behind approximate PEPS contraction. Finally, tensor-network representations of mixed states, quantum channels, and Lindblad dynamics are presented, with applications to thermal states and open quantum systems. The presentation is accompanied by short Julia code examples based on ITensor, ITensorMPS, and TensorMixedStates. These notes were written for the 9th Les Houches Summer School on Computational Physics: Open Quantum Systems, held in June 2026.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“tensor-network methods”、“MPS algorithms”、“Julia code examples”，属于计算方法与理论框架介绍。；研究对象：量子多体物理中的张量网络方法，重点研究矩阵乘积态（MPS）及其在量子多体系统中的应用，包括热态、开放量子系统等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现，主要目的是系统介绍张量网络方法（尤其是MPS）的基本概念、算法及其在量子多体物理中的应用框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现，主要目的是系统介绍张量网络方法（尤其是MPS）的基本概念、算法及其在量子多体物理中的应用框架。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，该笔记为2026年Les Houches暑期学校的讲义，旨在系统整合并教学性地介绍张量网络方法在开放量子系统中的应用。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法，包括图形符号、虚拟指标、键维数、规范自由度、正则形式、QR分解、奇异值分解；主要算法包括收缩、关联函数、矩阵乘积算符、DMRG、时间演化方法；以及投影纠缠对态（PEPS）的近似收缩方法；混合态、量子信道、Lindblad动力学的张量网络表示。附有基于ITensor、ITensorMPS、TensorMixedStates的Julia代码示例。

papers.title: The Interplay of Thermal Melting and Pump Driven Melting of Charge Order: A Two-Temperature Study of the Holstein Model
papers.abstract: Charge order driven by electron-phonon coupling is well understood at equilibrium but pump-probe experiments raise a new question: how does this order melt and recover after strong photoexcitation? A pump pulse promotes carriers across the charge-order gap and creates a nonequilibrium high-energy electronic population. In a closed system the subsequent dynamics is constrained by energy conservation. In an `open system' - where the system is coupled to a thermal bath at some temperature $T_{\rm bath}$ - there are new fluctuation and dissipation processes at play. One can attempt a computational scheme that incorporates coupling of electrons to a laser pump, the coupling of system phonons to a thermal bath, and the Holstein interaction that couples electrons and phonons. We attempt an approximation where the pump induced electronic excitations are modeled by a slowly time varying `electron temperature', $T_{\rm el}(t)$, indicative of a quasi-equilibrium electronic state. We solve the problem for different combinations of $T_{\rm el}$ and $T_{\rm bath}$, probing the order parameter dynamics, the static properties and excitations in the long time `quasi steady state', and establish a `phase diagram' in terms of bath temperature and electron temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：computational scheme、approximation、phase diagram。；研究对象：Holstein模型中由电子-声子耦合驱动的电荷有序态在光激发下的热熔化与泵浦驱动熔化之间的相互作用，以及非平衡态下的熔化与恢复动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入随时间缓慢变化的“电子温度”$T_{\rm el}(t)$和固定热浴温度$T_{\rm bath}$，建立了电荷有序态在长时间“准稳态”下的相图，揭示了热浴温度与电子温度对有序参量动力学和静态性质的共同影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入随时间缓慢变化的“电子温度”$T_{\rm el}(t)$和固定热浴温度$T_{\rm bath}$，建立了电荷有序态在长时间“准稳态”下的相图，揭示了热浴温度与电子温度对有序参量动力学和静态性质的共同影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双温度近似方法，将泵浦诱导的电子激发建模为准平衡电子温度$T_{\rm el}(t)$，同时考虑系统声子与热浴的耦合以及电子-声子Holstein相互作用，通过求解不同$T_{\rm el}$和$T_{\rm bath}$组合下的动力学问题，分析有序参量演化和准稳态性质。

papers.title: On Degeneracies of Density, Magnetic, and Pairing Responses: How Competing Orders Echo Underlying Symmetries in the Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated electron systems often display competing or even intertwined ordering tendencies, hinting to extremely close or degenerate many-electron energies. While degeneracies are directly rooted in the underlying symmetries of the problem under investigation, their multifaceted effects on different response functions and their mutual relations often remain elusive. Here we put this subject on a rigorous basis by investigating the degeneracies of charge, spin, and pairing susceptibilities for the unfrustrated, bipartite Hubbard model. Exploiting its pseudospin symmetry, we analytically derive the mutual relations between these response functions for generic spatial modulations, highly relevant, e.g., for the competition of stripe and superconducting orders. By means of two-particle numerical simulations we demonstrate the occurrence of a simultaneous $d$-wave pairing/$d$-density wave (loop current) instability in the vicinity of the metal-insulator transition, driven by short-ranged spin fluctuations for the two-dimensional case. We show how this degeneracy is gradually lifted by geometrical frustration, which favors superconductivity. Our study provides a general tool for revealing symmetry relations in correlated electron systems and establishes a unifying perspective on the nature of their intermingled charge/loop current, pairing, and spin orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。关键词：analytically derive、two-particle numerical simulations、pseudospin symmetry。；研究对象：无阻挫、二分的Hubbard模型中的电荷、自旋和配对响应函数的简并性，以及条纹序与超导序的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维Hubbard模型的金属-绝缘体转变附近，由短程自旋涨落驱动，同时出现d波配对与d-密度波（环流）不稳定性；几何阻挫会逐渐解除这种简并，并有利于超导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维Hubbard模型的金属-绝缘体转变附近，由短程自旋涨落驱动，同时出现d波配对与d-密度波（环流）不稳定性；几何阻挫会逐渐解除这种简并，并有利于超导。；创新点：将竞争序的简并性置于严格的对称性基础上，系统揭示了Hubbard模型中密度、磁性和配对响应函数之间的解析关系，并建立了电荷/环流序、配对序和自旋序相互交织的统一视角。
papers.method_zh: 利用赝自旋对称性解析推导了不同响应函数（电荷、自旋、配对磁化率）之间的相互关系；结合双粒子数值模拟（two-particle numerical simulations）验证了二维情况下的简并不稳定性。

papers.title: On the localization transition from MAA to AA models
papers.abstract: Despite their potential similarity between the mosaic Aubry-André (MAA) and AA models, the MAA model allows mobility edges (MEs), whereas the AA model does not. Here we develop a new double quasiperiodic MAA (DMAA) model consisting of one primitive MAA with nonzero even-site potentials and the other modified one with both nonzero odd-site potentials and a tunable amplitude factor, to reveal how localization transitions evolve from MAA to AA models. Interplays and competitions among the extended, critical and localized states arising from superpositions of double quasi-periodic MAA potentials enable new twice and multiple localization-delocalization transitions besides the original single localization transition. Our numerical calculations on inverse participation ratio, normalized participation ratio, fractal dimension and real-space wavefunction distribution confirm such localization features. The continuum model simulations on the experimental polariton modes also yield consistent results and hence validate their experimental feasibility. The constructed DMAA model provides a new framework for studying the localization transition processes between two analogous quasiperiodic models and broadens the understanding of Anderson localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算与数值模拟为主，辅以连续模型模拟验证实验可行性。判断依据：关键词“numerical calculations”“continuum model simulations”“inverse participation ratio, normalized participation ratio, fractal dimension”。；研究对象：双准周期MAA（DMAA）模型中的局域化转变过程，具体研究从MAA模型到AA模型局域化行为的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建双准周期MAA模型，发现除了原有的单次局域化转变外，还出现了新的两次及多次局域化-退局域化转变，这些转变源于双准周期MAA势叠加产生的扩展态、临界态和局域态之间的相互作用与竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建双准周期MAA模型，发现除了原有的单次局域化转变外，还出现了新的两次及多次局域化-退局域化转变，这些转变源于双准周期MAA势叠加产生的扩展态、临界态和局域态之间的相互作用与竞争。；创新点：构建了双准周期MAA模型，揭示了从MAA模型到AA模型局域化转变的演化过程，为研究两个类似准周期模型之间的局域化转变提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算：逆参与率、归一化参与率、分形维数、实空间波函数分布；连续模型模拟：用于验证实验可行性（如极化激元模式）。

papers.title: Thermal stability of vapor-deposited stable glasses of an organic semiconductor
papers.abstract: Vapor-deposited organic glasses can show enhanced kinetic stability relative to liquid-cooled glasses. When such stable glasses of model glassformers are annealed above the glass transition temperature Tg, they lose their thermal stability and transform into the supercooled liquid via constant velocity propagating fronts. In this work, we show that vapor-deposited glasses of an organic semiconductor, N,N-bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N-diphenylbenzidine (TPD), also transform via propagating fronts. Using spectroscopic ellipsometry and a new high-throughput annealing protocol, we measure transformation front velocities for TPD glasses prepared with substrate temperatures (TSubstrate) from 0.63 to 0.96 Tg, at many different annealing temperatures. We observe that the front velocity varies by over an order of magnitude with TSubstrate, while the activation energy remains constant. Using dielectric spectroscopy, we measure the structural relaxation time of supercooled TPD. We find that the mobility of the liquid and the structure of the glass are independent factors in controlling the thermal stability of TPD films. In comparison to model glassformers, the transformation fronts of TPD have similar velocities and a similar dependence on TSubstrate, suggesting universal behavior. These results may aid in designing active layers in organic electronic devices with improved thermal stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了使用“spectroscopic ellipsometry”（光谱椭偏仪）、“a new high-throughput annealing protocol”（新的高通量退火方案）和“dielectric spectroscopy”（介电谱）等实验手段进行测量。；研究对象：有机半导体材料N,N-双(3-甲基苯基)-N,N-二苯基联苯胺（TPD）的气相沉积稳定玻璃薄膜。具体物理现象是这类玻璃在退火过程中的热稳定性及其通过传播前沿向过冷液体转变的动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有机半导体TPD的气相沉积稳定玻璃在退火时也通过恒定速度的传播前沿转变为过冷液体；其前沿速度随沉积基底温度变化超过一个数量级，但活化能保持不变。研究发现，过冷液体的迁移率和玻璃的结构是控制TPD薄膜热稳定性的两个独立因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有机半导体TPD的气相沉积稳定玻璃在退火时也通过恒定速度的传播前沿转变为过冷液体；其前沿速度随沉积基底温度变化超过一个数量级，但活化能保持不变。研究发现，过冷液体的迁移率和玻璃的结构是控制TPD薄膜热稳定性的两个独立因素。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段包括：1）光谱椭偏仪，用于测量薄膜厚度和光学性质；2）一种新的高通量退火方案，用于在不同退火温度下高效测量转变前沿速度；3）介电谱，用于测量过冷TPD的结构弛豫时间。

papers.title: Fractional Magnonic Frequency Combs
papers.abstract: Magnonic frequency combs (MFCs) are spectacular phenomena in microwave-driven high-quality magnets. Like the equally spaced prongs in a comb, conventional \textit{integer} MFCs are sharp resonances with an equal and constant frequency difference. Here we report \textit{fractional} MFCs in a high-quality magnetic sphere that emerges when adding a low-power, precisely detuned microwave to the main drive that compresses the frequency spacings to a rational fraction of the original comb, generating high-density spectral grids with hundreds of lines. The theoretical analysis finds that parametric three-magnon scattering is the dominant non-linear process that reproduces the observation well. This mechanism is unique to magnets: it does not exist in an optomechanical system, where the Kerr and optical nonlinearities govern comb formation at a much higher power input. Since our platform operates as a frequency ``vernier caliper" with much higher sensitivity than integer MFCs, it has application potential in precision metrology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：report、observation、experimental platform）；研究对象：微波驱动的高品质磁性球体中的分数阶磁子频率梳（fractional magnonic frequency combs）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原有主驱动微波基础上，额外施加一个低功率、精确失谐的微波，可将频率梳的间隔压缩为原始梳的有理分数，产生具有数百条谱线的高密度频谱网格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原有主驱动微波基础上，额外施加一个低功率、精确失谐的微波，可将频率梳的间隔压缩为原始梳的有理分数，产生具有数百条谱线的高密度频谱网格。；创新点：首次在磁子系统中实现分数阶频率梳，其形成机制（参量三磁子散射）与光机械系统中基于Kerr和光学非线性的梳形成不同，且该平台作为频率“游标卡尺”具有比整数磁子频率梳更高的灵敏度，在精密计量中有应用潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用高品质磁性球体，施加双微波驱动（主驱动+低功率失谐微波）；理论上通过参量三磁子散射非线性过程进行分析，并与实验结果吻合。

papers.title: Anderson localization on the Bethe lattice
papers.abstract: Anderson localization is a paradigmatic disorder-driven quantum phase transition in which interference effects can completely suppress wave propagation. Its formulation on the Bethe lattice -- an infinite tree with fixed coordination number -- provides a unique setting in which the transition becomes analytically tractable. Owing to its exponential volume growth, the Bethe lattice realizes the infinite-dimensional limit of the Anderson problem and also serves as a useful mean-field-like description of localization in many-body configuration spaces. These lecture notes provide a pedagogical review of Anderson localization on the Bethe lattice, focusing on the resolvent (Green's function) formalism and the cavity approach. We discuss the main diagnostics of localization and show how they are encoded in the statistical properties of Green's functions, with the full probability distribution of the local density of states emerging as the natural order parameter of the transition. We derive the cavity self-consistent equations for the diagonal resolvent and review both their numerical solution by population dynamics and their analytical treatment in the large-connectivity limit. This framework gives access to the critical disorder and the critical behavior near the transition, including the localization length in the insulating phase and the correlation volume that controls the delocalized phase. We also discuss the connection with directed polymers in random media and its interpretation in terms of rare resonant paths and freezing phenomena. These notes originated from a series of lectures delivered by one of the authors at the Oropa Summer School on "Fundamental Problems in Statistical Physics XVI" (July 2025).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：pedagogical review, resolvent formalism, cavity approach, analytical treatment）；研究对象：贝特晶格上的安德森局域化相变（一种无序驱动的量子相变，涉及波传播的完全抑制）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过格林函数统计性质（尤其是局域态密度的全概率分布）作为序参量，系统描述了贝特晶格上安德森局域化的诊断方法、临界行为及局域化长度与关联体积。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过格林函数统计性质（尤其是局域态密度的全概率分布）作为序参量，系统描述了贝特晶格上安德森局域化的诊断方法、临界行为及局域化长度与关联体积。；创新点：以教学综述形式系统整合了贝特晶格上安德森局域化的解析框架，特别强调了局域态密度概率分布作为序参量的角色，并讨论了与随机介质中有向聚合物及稀有共振路径、冻结现象的关联。摘要未突出说明与已有综述相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数（传播子）形式与空腔方法，推导了对角传播子的空腔自洽方程，并通过种群动力学进行数值求解，同时在大连接数极限下进行解析处理。

papers.title: Simulating the Haldane model in ultra-clean GaAs heterostructures
papers.abstract: The Haldane model represents the minimal lattice-based realization of a Chern insulator, exhibiting a quantized Hall conductance in the absence of Landau levels. Despite its conceptual elegance, the implementation in crystalline solids of the requisite pattern of Peierls phases breaking time-reversal symmetry remains experimentally demanding. In this work, we theoretically investigate the possibility to simulate the Haldane model in ultra-clean GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructures. Our proposal relies on recent experiments in which a high-mobility two-dimensional electron gas is subject to a gate-defined honeycomb electrostatic potential and a laterally periodic magnetic field generated by patterned ferromagnetic structures. The combined electrostatic and magnetic superlattices furnish a viable route to emulate the topological properties of the Haldane model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“theoretically investigate”，且未提及实验数据或计算模拟结果。；研究对象：在超净GaAs/AlGaAs异质结中模拟Haldane模型（Chern绝缘体）的可行性。具体体系为：高迁移率二维电子气受到栅极定义的石墨烯型静电势和铁磁结构产生的周期性横向磁场共同作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过静电和磁超晶格的联合调控，可以在GaAs/AlGaAs异质结中有效模拟Haldane模型的拓扑性质，实现无朗道能级下的量子化霍尔电导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过静电和磁超晶格的联合调控，可以在GaAs/AlGaAs异质结中有效模拟Haldane模型的拓扑性质，实现无朗道能级下的量子化霍尔电导。；创新点：提出利用成熟的GaAs/AlGaAs异质结技术（而非传统晶体固体）来实验实现Haldane模型所需的Peierls相位图案，从而规避在固体中直接实现时间反演对称性破缺的困难。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于已有实验（高迁移率二维电子气、栅极定义蜂窝状静电势、图案化铁磁结构产生周期性磁场）的可行性，构建静电-磁复合超晶格模型，分析其拓扑特性。

papers.title: AC Conductance in n-InSb Structures with Quantum Well. Acoustic Studies
papers.abstract: We studied the ac conductance of an $n$-InSb quantum well structure using acoustic methods in magnetic fields up to 18 T and at temperatures ranging from 20 to 500 mK. We attribute the unusual magnetic field dependences of surface acoustic wave (SAW) attenuation and velocity observed in the experiment to the presence of a conducting layer parallel to the quantum well in the sample. We successfully separated the contributions from both the quantum well and the shunting layer, enabling the identification of their distinct conduction mechanisms. Furthermore, by employing the coincidence technique, we determined the electron g-factor in the quantum well and investigated its dependence on the degree of spin polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“我们研究了……使用声学方法”“在实验中观察到……”，属于实验研究。；研究对象：n-InSb量子阱结构中的交流电导，以及与之平行的导电层（分流层）的输运行为。具体物理现象包括表面声波（SAW）衰减和速度的异常磁场依赖关系、电子g因子及其对自旋极化程度的依赖。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验观测到的表面声波衰减和速度的异常磁场依赖关系源于样品中存在一个与量子阱平行的导电层；通过分离量子阱和分流层的贡献，识别了它们不同的导电机制，并利用符合技术测定了量子阱中电子的g因子及其随自旋极化程度的变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验观测到的表面声波衰减和速度的异常磁场依赖关系源于样品中存在一个与量子阱平行的导电层；通过分离量子阱和分流层的贡献，识别了它们不同的导电机制，并利用符合技术测定了量子阱中电子的g因子及其随自旋极化程度的变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用声学方法（表面声波技术），在高达18 T的磁场和20–500 mK的极低温下测量n-InSb量子阱结构的交流电导。使用“符合技术”（coincidence technique）提取电子g因子。

papers.title: Limited surface mobility inhibits stable glass formation for 2-ethyl-1-hexanol
papers.abstract: Previous work has shown that vapor-deposition can prepare organic glasses with extremely high kinetic stabilities and other properties that would be expected from liquid-cooled glasses only after aging for thousands of years or more. However, recent reports have shown that some molecules form vapor-deposited glasses with only limited kinetic stability when prepared using conditions expected to yield a stable glass. In this work, we vapor deposit glasses of 2-ethyl-1-hexanol over a wide range of deposition rates and test several hypotheses for why this molecule does not form highly stable glasses under normal deposition conditions. The kinetic stability of 2-ethyl-1-hexanol glasses is found to be highly dependent on the deposition rate. For deposition at Tsubstrate = 0.90 Tg, the kinetic stability increases by 3 orders of magnitude (as measured by isothermal transformation times) when the deposition rate is decreased from 0.2 nm/s to 0.005 nm/s. We also find that, for the same preparation time, a vapor-deposited glass has much more kinetic stability than an aged liquid-cooled glass. Our results support the hypothesis that the formation of highly stable 2-ethyl-1-hexanol glasses is inhibited by limited surface mobility. We compare our deposition rate experiments to similar ones performed with ethylcyclohexane (which readily forms glasses of high kinetic stability); we estimate that the surface mobility of 2-ethyl-1-hexanol is more than 4 orders of magnitude less than that of ethylcyclohexane at 0.85 Tg.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“vapor deposit glasses”、“deposition rate experiments”等实验操作和测量。；研究对象：2-ethyl-1-hexanol（2-乙基-1-己醇）分子形成的蒸汽沉积玻璃，以及其动力学稳定性与表面迁移率的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 2-ethyl-1-hexanol在蒸汽沉积条件下难以形成高动力学稳定性的玻璃，其根本原因是表面迁移率极低（在0.85 Tg下比乙基环己烷低超过4个数量级）。通过降低沉积速率，其动力学稳定性可提升3个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：2-ethyl-1-hexanol在蒸汽沉积条件下难以形成高动力学稳定性的玻璃，其根本原因是表面迁移率极低（在0.85 Tg下比乙基环己烷低超过4个数量级）。通过降低沉积速率，其动力学稳定性可提升3个数量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒸汽沉积方法制备玻璃，在宽沉积速率范围（0.2 nm/s至0.005 nm/s）和特定基底温度（Tsubstrate = 0.90 Tg）下进行实验。通过等温转变时间测量动力学稳定性，并与乙基环己烷的类似实验进行对比。

papers.title: Dynamics and stability of inertial flexible chains under follower activity
papers.abstract: The dynamics of flexible polymers and chains under follower activity is known to produce diverse nonequilibrium states. A prominent feature of such systems is the emergence of periodic motion arising from the coupling between internal activity and chain conformation. Recently, it has been shown that flexible and extensible chains of active particles exhibit rich dynamical patterns in the overdamped limit, where inertia is negligible. Here, we study the complex dynamics of a flexible and extensible chain of active particles under follower activity when inertia is significant. Using numerical simulations, we quantify the chain dynamics as a function of chain length ($N$), segment mass, and activity. To rationalize the numerical results, we develop theoretical descriptions in the limit of short chains ($N=3$) and long chains ($N \gg 1$). In both these limits, we derive approximate expressions for the bond lengths and bond angles along the contour, which show excellent agreement with the numerical results. In addition, for short chains, we derive the stability conditions for a periodic motion as a function of segment mass and activity. For long chains ($N\gg1$) we identify parameter regime in which the circular, periodic solution becomes structurally unstable. Our theoretical and numerical analysis provides insights into the emergence of ordered and periodic behaviour in active chains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：numerical simulations、theoretical descriptions、derive approximate expressions、stability conditions。；研究对象：受追随者活性驱动的柔性可伸缩链（flexible and extensible chain of active particles）的动力学与稳定性，重点关注惯性效应显著时的非平衡态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在惯性显著条件下，活性柔性链的动力学行为依赖于链长、段质量和活性强度；短链（N=3）和长链（N≫1）的键长与键角近似表达式与数值模拟高度吻合，且短链的周期运动稳定性条件及长链的圆形周期解结构不稳定性参数区间被确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在惯性显著条件下，活性柔性链的动力学行为依赖于链长、段质量和活性强度；短链（N=3）和长链（N≫1）的键长与键角近似表达式与数值模拟高度吻合，且短链的周期运动稳定性条件及长链的圆形周期解结构不稳定性参数区间被确定。；创新点：将研究从过阻尼极限（惯性可忽略）拓展到惯性显著情形，系统分析了惯性对活性柔性链动力学模式的影响，并给出了短链和长链极限下的解析描述与稳定性判据。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（量化链动力学随链长N、段质量、活性的变化）；理论推导（短链N=3和长链N≫1极限下的键长、键角近似表达式，以及短链周期运动稳定性条件）。

papers.title: Quantum droplets and condensates in an optical lattice coupled to a dissipative cavity: Collective excitations and non-equilibrium dynamics
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent experiments on light-matter interacting systems, we investigate a dilute Bose gas and self-bound quantum droplets in a one-dimensional optical lattice coupled to a lossy cavity mode. Using a classical-field approach, we determine the stationary states and collective excitations of this non-equilibrium system. Apart from the usual Bogoliubov modes, we identify a polariton-like gapped excitation, the frequency of which softens as a precursor of the density ordering transition. Moreover, its relaxation time diverges as the critical point is approached, signaling the non-equilibrium nature of this transition. Dynamically, this polariton-like mode can be probed by inducing cavity field fluctuations, which in turn generates spatio-temporal oscillations of both the condensate and droplet states. In the droplet regime, we also analyze the bound modes which bear the characteristics of such non-equilibrium self-bound state. In addition, we uncover solitonic non-equilibrium states, including condensate with kink-like configuration and double-droplet state, and investigate their robustness following a sudden quench. Remarkably, although these states become unstable beyond a critical coupling, they continue to manifest in the dynamics, akin to the scarring phenomena. Our results demonstrate that dissipative cavity coupling provides a versatile route for exploring rich non-equilibrium dynamics of condensates and quantum droplets within experimentally accessible settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“classical-field approach”（经典场方法）、“determine the stationary states and collective excitations”（确定稳态和集体激发）、“analyze the bound modes”（分析束缚模式），属于理论计算与数值分析。；研究对象：一维光晶格中耦合到耗散腔模的稀薄玻色气体和自束缚量子液滴，以及该非平衡系统中的集体激发和非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出除常规Bogoliubov模式外的一种类极化子有隙激发，其频率在密度有序化转变前软化，且弛豫时间在临界点发散，揭示了该转变的非平衡本质；在液滴区域发现了非平衡自束缚态的特征束缚模式，并揭示了类似疤痕现象的孤子型非平衡态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出除常规Bogoliubov模式外的一种类极化子有隙激发，其频率在密度有序化转变前软化，且弛豫时间在临界点发散，揭示了该转变的非平衡本质；在液滴区域发现了非平衡自束缚态的特征束缚模式，并揭示了类似疤痕现象的孤子型非平衡态。；创新点：将耗散腔耦合引入光晶格中的玻色气体和量子液滴系统，系统研究了非平衡集体激发、自束缚态束缚模式以及类似疤痕现象的孤子型非平衡态，展示了耗散腔耦合作为探索丰富非平衡动力学的可行途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典场方法（classical-field approach）求解非平衡系统的稳态和集体激发，通过诱导腔场涨落探测动力学响应，并分析淬火后的动力学演化。

papers.title: Optical spectroscopy of Bose-Einstein condensates at finite temperature
papers.abstract: We report on optical spectroscopic measurements of ultracold and partially condensed 87Rb gases, which show distinct spectral features due to the thermal and the Bose condensed components in the frequency domain. These features are detected in-situ by using a dark-field configuration with single-photon sensitivity and a frequency-agile laser system. To interpret the observed spectra, we develop a model for light propagation through an inhomogeneous atomic cloud. This model enables the extraction of temperature and atom number, which we benchmark against conventional time-of-flight absorption imaging. The spectroscopically obtained cloud parameters show enhanced sensitivity to small thermal fractions in nearly pure condensates. We further compare the spectroscopy in dark-field and bright-field configurations, demonstrating the superior performance of the former. Our results reveal previously unexplored spectral structure in optically dense ultracold gases and establish spectroscopy as a tool for characterizing ultracold systems at very low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：optical spectroscopic measurements、in-situ、dark-field configuration、single-photon sensitivity、frequency-agile laser system。；研究对象：超冷且部分凝聚的⁸⁷Rb玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）在有限温度下的光学光谱特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在频率域中，热原子和玻色凝聚组分展现出不同的光谱特征；暗场光谱配置相比亮场配置具有更优性能，且对近纯凝聚体中的微小热分数具有更高灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在频率域中，热原子和玻色凝聚组分展现出不同的光谱特征；暗场光谱配置相比亮场配置具有更优性能，且对近纯凝聚体中的微小热分数具有更高灵敏度。；创新点：首次揭示了光学稠密超冷气体中此前未被探索的光谱结构，并建立了光谱学作为极低温超冷系统表征工具的有效性。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用暗场成像配置结合单光子灵敏度和频率可调激光系统进行原位光谱测量；同时发展了一个描述光在非均匀原子云中传播的模型，用于提取温度和原子数，并通过传统飞行时间吸收成像进行基准验证。

papers.title: Anomalous Floquet Heating from Sparse Long-Range Interactions
papers.abstract: Regular lattices of interacting particles under a periodic drive typically heat with rate $γ\sim e^{-\mathcal{O}(ω)}$ which is exponentially suppressed in drive frequency $ω$. Here, we show that sparse infinite-range interactions, which have recently become accessible in quantum simulators, can lead to anomalous heating with rate $γ\sim e^{-\mathcal{O}(\sqrtω)}$. This anomaly originates from the broad distribution of coordination numbers across the network: as the driving frequency increases, heating becomes dominated by sites with larger coordination numbers, making the characteristic local energy scale relevant for heating grow with frequency. For small-world networks, we develop an analytic theory that thoroughly matches our large scale numerics. Finally, we discuss how network topology can serve as a control knob for engineering non-equilibrium phases of matter. Our results uncover a new mechanism for Floquet heating and suggest new routes toward stabilizing nonequilibrium phases in driven systems with programmable interaction networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic theory、large scale numerics、develop an analytic theory。；研究对象：受周期驱动（Floquet）的相互作用粒子系统，具体研究稀疏无限程相互作用（sparse infinite-range interactions）导致的异常加热现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在稀疏无限程相互作用网络中，Floquet加热速率γ随驱动频率ω的衰减方式从常规的指数型γ∼e^{-O(ω)}变为反常的γ∼e^{-O(√ω)}，这一异常源于网络中配位数（coordination numbers）的宽分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在稀疏无限程相互作用网络中，Floquet加热速率γ随驱动频率ω的衰减方式从常规的指数型γ∼e^{-O(ω)}变为反常的γ∼e^{-O(√ω)}，这一异常源于网络中配位数（coordination numbers）的宽分布。；创新点：揭示了由稀疏长程相互作用网络拓扑结构引起的新型Floquet加热机制，并提出网络拓扑可作为调控非平衡物质相（non-equilibrium phases of matter）的控制旋钮。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论（analytic theory）与小世界网络（small-world networks）模型，结合大规模数值模拟（large scale numerics）进行验证。

papers.title: Multicomponent Grain Boundary Segregation Dilute-Limit Model and Its Effect on Nanocrystalline Stability
papers.abstract: Grain boundary segregation of solutes is a powerful tool for stabilizing nanocrystalline materials. However, previous studies developed an approach to calculate stabilization only in binary systems. In this work, we derive a spectral segregation model for an arbitrary number of solutes in the dilute limit (neglecting solute--solute interactions) and demonstrate that multicomponent segregation substantially expands the range of nanocrystalline alloys thermodynamically stable against both grain growth and phase separation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive a spectral segregation model（推导谱分离模型）、dilute limit（稀极限）、neglecting solute-solute interactions（忽略溶质-溶质相互作用）。；研究对象：多组分溶质在晶界偏析对纳米晶材料稳定性的影响，具体为任意数量溶质在稀极限下的热力学稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多组分晶界偏析能显著扩大热力学稳定的纳米晶合金范围，使其同时抵抗晶粒长大和相分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多组分晶界偏析能显著扩大热力学稳定的纳米晶合金范围，使其同时抵抗晶粒长大和相分离。；创新点：将此前仅适用于二元体系的晶界偏析稳定性计算方法推广至任意多组分体系，揭示了多组分偏析对纳米晶稳定性的增强作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于稀极限假设（忽略溶质-溶质相互作用），推导了一个适用于任意数量溶质的谱分离模型（spectral segregation model），用于计算多组分体系中的晶界偏析效应。

papers.title: Enabling Electrical Readout of Néel vector reversal in a van der Waals Antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Owing to its robustness against external perturbations and intrinsically ultrafast dynamics, the Néel vector in antiferromagnets (AFMs) can enable the development of next-generation spintronic and magnonic devices for memory and computing applications. To realize AFM-based magnetic memory devices, one of the key requirements is to demonstrate electrical readout of 180-degree reversal of Néel vector in thin film AFMs, which remains critically missing. In this work, we report experimental demonstration of a novel transport methodology to detect Néel vector reversal in atomically thin films of a van der Waals (vdW) based A-type AFM. For this, we utilize spin-dependent electronic band properties of CrSBr by coupling it to a spin-polarized layer, separated by a tunnel barrier. In this configuration, the spin-dependent tunnelling magnetoresistance (MR) becomes sensitive to the relative orientation between the magnetization of the reference electrode and the interfacial sublattice magnetization of the AFM layer, in turn enabling electrical detection of the Néel vector orientation. Importantly, the observed MR can also reveal 180-degree reversal of Néel vector in even-layers of CrSBr, wherein adjacent sublattice magnetic layers are exactly compensated and the net magnetization vanishes and thus establishes a broadly applicable strategy for electrical detection of Néel vector in vdW-based AFMs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimental demonstration”、“report”、“utilize”等关键词，描述了具体的器件制备和测量结果。；研究对象：基于范德华（vdW）A型反铁磁体CrSBr的薄膜，具体研究其奈尔矢量（Néel vector）的180度翻转及其电学读出。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将CrSBr与自旋极化层通过隧穿势垒耦合，利用自旋依赖的隧穿磁电阻（MR）效应，成功实现了对原子级薄层反铁磁体中奈尔矢量取向的电学检测，包括在偶数层（净磁化强度为零）中奈尔矢量180度翻转的读出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将CrSBr与自旋极化层通过隧穿势垒耦合，利用自旋依赖的隧穿磁电阻（MR）效应，成功实现了对原子级薄层反铁磁体中奈尔矢量取向的电学检测，包括在偶数层（净磁化强度为零）中奈尔矢量180度翻转的读出。；创新点：首次实验演示了在薄膜反铁磁体中实现奈尔矢量180度翻转的电学读出，填补了该领域的关键空白，并为基于范德华反铁磁体的电学检测提供了普适策略。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建了自旋隧穿结器件，将范德华反铁磁体CrSBr与自旋极化参考电极通过隧穿势垒耦合，测量自旋依赖的隧穿磁电阻（MR）随奈尔矢量取向的变化。

papers.title: Magnetoelectric flat band induced by a $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ charge density wave in monolayer CrSe$_2$
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic and magnetic properties of the polar $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ charge-density-wave (CDW) phase of CrSe$_2$ using ab initio calculations. The CDW introduces a polar distortion out of the van der Waals plane that couples to the spin-polarized Cr d states resulting in a remarkably flat electronic band exactly at the Fermi level. We provide a microscopic understanding of the origin of the flat band by analyzing in detail the structural reconstruction, the effects of orbital hybridization, crystal-field splittings, spin-orbit coupling and electronic correlations. Our calculations show that due to the polar nature of the CDW distortion, an electric field can act as an external switch to induce the CDW phase, providing a way to manipulate strong correlations in the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“ab initio calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：单层CrSe₂在极性√3×√3电荷密度波（CDW）相中的电子与磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CDW引起的面外极性畸变与自旋极化的Cr d态耦合，在费米能级处产生一条非常平坦的电子能带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CDW引起的面外极性畸变与自旋极化的Cr d态耦合，在费米能级处产生一条非常平坦的电子能带。；创新点：揭示了CDW畸变的极性本质使得外加电场可作为外部开关诱导CDW相，从而提供了一种调控体系中强关联效应的方法。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations），具体包括分析结构重构、轨道杂化、晶体场劈裂、自旋-轨道耦合以及电子关联效应。

papers.title: Breaking Bottlenecks in Solid Electrolyte Discovery with Large Artificial Intelligence Models
papers.abstract: Solid electrolytes (SEs) are central to next-generation metal batteries, yet their discovery remains constrained by fragmented data, limited transferability of simulations, and slow experimental iteration. Unlike catalysis, where surface reactivity dominates, SEs require simultaneous optimization of bulk ion transport, defect chemistry, mechanical integrity, and interfacial stability. Here, we outline a framework for autonomous SE discovery enabled by large artificial intelligence (AI) models, including machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and large language models (LLMs). We discuss the evolution from static materials databases to dynamic, self-updating knowledge systems, the role of MLIPs in bridging density functional theory (DFT) and long-timescale ion migration, and the emergence of LLMs as engines for literature mining, hypothesis generation, and scientific reasoning. We further describe a closed-loop architecture integrating AI-driven candidate design, multiscale simulation, uncertainty-aware selection, and experimental validation. Such systems shift SE research from intuition-guided exploration to data-informed, self-improving cycles. We conclude by highlighting challenges in data standardization, interfacial complexity, and reproducibility, and we propose design principles for building autonomous laboratories for solid-state battery materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（观点/框架性文章）。判断依据：摘要中使用了“outline a framework”、“discuss the evolution”、“describe a closed-loop architecture”等表述，旨在提出一个研究范式或路线图，而非报告具体的实验或计算结果。；研究对象：固态电解质（Solid Electrolytes, SEs），用于下一代金属电池。研究聚焦于其体相离子输运、缺陷化学、力学完整性和界面稳定性等关键性能的协同优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 大型人工智能模型（包括机器学习原子间势MLIPs和大语言模型LLMs）能够打破固态电解质发现中的数据碎片化、模拟可迁移性差和实验迭代慢等瓶颈，实现从直觉驱动到数据驱动的自主发现闭环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：大型人工智能模型（包括机器学习原子间势MLIPs和大语言模型LLMs）能够打破固态电解质发现中的数据碎片化、模拟可迁移性差和实验迭代慢等瓶颈，实现从直觉驱动到数据驱动的自主发现闭环。；创新点：本文的创新在于提出了一个将大型AI模型（MLIPs和LLMs）系统性地整合到固态电解质发现中的自主实验室框架，将研究范式从静态数据库和直觉探索，转变为动态、自更新的知识系统和数据驱动的自优化循环。摘要未突出说明与已有具体AI材料发现工作的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 本文提出了一套方法论框架，具体包括：

papers.title: Dimensional Confinement Driven Scattering Inversion in NaCrTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Dimensionality reduction provides a powerful route to tune the electronic and magnetic properties of van der Waals materials, yet its influence on electronic transport remains complex due to competing effects from quantum confinement and modified scattering mechanisms. Here, we investigate this interplay in an antiferromagnetic semiconductor $\text{NaCrTe}_2$ using first-principles calculations combined with the Boltzmann transport equation beyond the constant relaxation time approximation. Our results show that the monolayer limit induces a coupled magnetostructural reconstruction, reducing the band gap from $0.44$ eV (bulk) to $0.15$ eV (monolayer) and significantly enhancing the static dielectric constant. This evolution triggers a fundamental scattering inversion: whereas bulk transport is limited by polar optical phonon (POP) scattering, the monolayer becomes dominated by acoustic deformation potential (ADP) scattering. We show that this crossover originates from the simultaneous suppression of the Fröhlich interaction through enhanced dielectric screening and the amplification of acoustic scattering due to pronounced lattice softening. These results clarify how the interplay between dielectric screening, lattice stiffness, and band topology governs transport in low-dimensional magnetic semiconductors, providing a framework to optimize their electronic performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations、Boltzmann transport equation、constant relaxation time approximation。；研究对象：反铁磁半导体 NaCrTe₂ 在从体材料到单层极限下的电子输运性质，特别是维度降低对散射机制的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 NaCrTe₂ 中，从体材料到单层极限会引发散射机制的根本性反转：体材料中输运受极性光学声子（POP）散射主导，而单层中则变为声学形变势（ADP）散射主导。这一反转源于维度降低导致的介电屏蔽增强和晶格软化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 NaCrTe₂ 中，从体材料到单层极限会引发散射机制的根本性反转：体材料中输运受极性光学声子（POP）散射主导，而单层中则变为声学形变势（ADP）散射主导。这一反转源于维度降低导致的介电屏蔽增强和晶格软化。；创新点：揭示了在低维磁性半导体中，介电屏蔽、晶格刚度和能带拓扑之间的相互作用如何共同决定输运行为，并首次在 NaCrTe₂ 中发现了维度驱动下的散射机制反转现象。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合超越恒定弛豫时间近似的玻尔兹曼输运方程（Boltzmann transport equation beyond the constant relaxation time approximation）。

papers.title: From Continuous-Time Random Walks to Laplace Tails
papers.abstract: During Brownian motion, the displacement is normally distributed, a classical fact aligned with the central limit theorem. However, single particle tracking in complex media such as glasses, living cells, and colloidal suspensions often reveals pronounced exponential decay of the displacement distribution, known as Laplace tails. In a short letter, two of us presented the emergence of Laplace tails in the continuous time random walk (CTRW) framework. Here, a detailed complementary study is presented. By exploring the behavior of $Q_t(n)$, the probability that exactly $n$ renewals occur during time $t$, we develop a rate function-like framework for this quantity, valid for finite $t$. We show that $Q_t(n)$ exhibits exponential tails, which in turn give rise to exponential tails of the positional probability density function $P(x,t)$. Favorable comparison to finite-time numerical simulations and asymptotic large deviation rate functions establishes the validity of our results over a wide temporal range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：continuous time random walk framework, rate function-like framework, theoretical analysis）；研究对象：连续时间随机游走（CTRW）框架中位移分布呈现拉普拉斯尾部（Laplace tails）的物理现象，涉及复杂介质（如玻璃、活细胞、胶体悬浮液）中的单粒子追踪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CTRW框架中，有限时间内发生恰好n次更新的概率Q_t(n)具有指数尾部，这直接导致位置概率密度函数P(x,t)呈现指数衰减的拉普拉斯尾部。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CTRW框架中，有限时间内发生恰好n次更新的概率Q_t(n)具有指数尾部，这直接导致位置概率密度函数P(x,t)呈现指数衰减的拉普拉斯尾部。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建Q_t(n)的类速率函数（rate function-like）理论框架，结合有限时间数值模拟和渐近大偏差速率函数进行对比验证。

papers.title: The impact of population heterogeneity on the redundancy principle
papers.abstract: Biological signaling is often governed by extreme value statistics, where a rapid response relies on the fastest few out of a large redundant group of searchers. While extreme first passage time (FPT) theory is well established for homogeneous ensembles, its sensitivity to population heterogeneity remains open. We show that averaging over a heterogeneous population of memoryless random walkers gives rise to ensemble self-reinforcement. This heterogeneity drastically changes both the FPT and minimum FPT densities relative to a homogeneous ensemble with identical mean rates. The modal and minimum FPTs are an order of magnitude smaller for heterogeneous populations relative to homogeneous ones. Our exact analytical predictions establish that population heterogeneity is a parameter that biology can exploit and not merely noise to be averaged away.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：extreme first passage time theory、exact analytical predictions、ensemble self-reinforcement。；研究对象：生物信号传导中冗余搜索群体的极端首次通过时间（FPT）统计，具体研究群体异质性（population heterogeneity）对冗余原则（redundancy principle）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 群体异质性会导致“集体自增强”效应，使得异质群体的模态和最小首次通过时间比同质群体小一个数量级，表明异质性不是可被平均掉的噪声，而是生物学可利用的参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：群体异质性会导致“集体自增强”效应，使得异质群体的模态和最小首次通过时间比同质群体小一个数量级，表明异质性不是可被平均掉的噪声，而是生物学可利用的参数。；创新点：首次严格证明群体异质性会根本性地改变极端首次通过时间的统计行为，揭示异质性本身可作为调控冗余搜索效率的主动参数，而非仅是被动噪声。
papers.method_zh: 基于极端首次通过时间理论，对无记忆随机游走者（memoryless random walkers）的异质群体进行解析平均，推导出异质与同质群体在FPT密度上的精确解析预测。

papers.title: Quintic-Anharmonicity-Assisted Three-Phonon Scattering: A Previously Overlooked Same-Order Channel to Four-Phonon Scattering
papers.abstract: Four-phonon scattering is widely regarded as the leading higher-order anharmonic correction to conventional three-phonon description of anharmonic scattering and lattice thermal transport. Here we show that diagrammatic perturbation theory contains another phonon linewidth contribution of the same perturbation order, arising from the coupling between cubic and quintic anharmonic vertices. We derive and implement this contribution from first principles and identify it as a quintic-anharmonicity-assisted three-phonon scattering channel. Although this process shares energy-conservation structure of the conventional three-phonon process, its perturbative order and temperature dependence resemble those of the conventional four-phonon process. For Si, we find that phonon scattering from this additional channel is comparable to four-phonon scattering over a broad frequency and temperature range, leading to a similar accelerated reduction of lattice thermal conductivity at high temperatures. We further show that in strongly anharmonic AgCl, this channel can become comparable to the ordinary three-phonon scattering even at room temperature. These results demonstrate that the commonly observed high-temperature enhanced scattering and suppression of lattice thermal conductivity might not be attributed uniquely to four-phonon process, and establish quintic-anharmonicity-assisted three-phonon scattering as a previously overlooked same-order channel in anharmonic lattice dynamics, which may be leveraged to uncover hidden microscopic thermal transport mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：diagrammatic perturbation theory, first principles, 微扰论推导与第一性原理计算）；研究对象：晶格中声子散射过程，具体为五阶非简谐性辅助的三声子散射通道，及其对晶格热导率的影响。材料体系包括硅（Si）和强非简谐性材料氯化银（AgCl）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种与四声子散射同阶但此前被忽略的声子线宽贡献——五阶非简谐性辅助的三声子散射。该通道在硅中与四声子散射强度相当，在AgCl中甚至可在室温下与普通三声子散射竞争，表明高温下热导率降低不能唯一归因于四声子过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种与四声子散射同阶但此前被忽略的声子线宽贡献——五阶非简谐性辅助的三声子散射。该通道在硅中与四声子散射强度相当，在AgCl中甚至可在室温下与普通三声子散射竞争，表明高温下热导率降低不能唯一归因于四声子过程。；创新点：首次识别并实现了五阶非简谐性辅助的三声子散射通道，证明其与四声子散射属于同一微扰阶数，但具有不同的能量守恒结构（类似三声子过程），揭示了高温热输运中一个此前被忽视的散射机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于图微扰理论（diagrammatic perturbation theory）推导出由三次和五次非简谐顶点耦合产生的新声子线宽贡献，并从第一性原理（first principles）实现该贡献的计算。

papers.title: Out-of-equilibrium scaling of the particle density in quantum fermionic wires after a critical quenching of the chemical potential
papers.abstract: We study the out-of-equilibrium scaling behavior of the particle density in quantum fermionic Kitaev wires, after instantaneous quantum quenches (QQs) of the chemical potential within their quantum critical region. The critical scaling of the ground-state particle density is known to be subleading at its Ising-like quantum transition, hidden by regular and logarithmic terms arising from peculiar mixings with the identity operator. This situation changes along the out-of-equilibrium dynamics arising from QQs of the chemical potential to the critical point, starting from the ground state for Hamiltonian parameters within the critical region. We analytically show that the difference between the post-QQ particle density and its critical value develops an out-of-equilibrium scaling behavior, in terms of the dynamic scaling variable $θ\sim t/ξ^z$ (where $t>0$ is the post-QQ time, $ξ$ is the length scale of the initial state, and $z$ is the dynamic critical exponent) associated with the post-QQ time evolution. The scaling function turns out to have a peculiar singular behavior in the $θ\to 0$ limit, apparently related to the anomalous equilibrium scaling behavior of the particle density at the starting point of the QQ protocol. This provides analytical evidence of earlier conjectures on the general emergence of post-QQ dynamic scaling behaviors of the subtracted particle density (supported by numerical finite-size scaling analyses), unlike their equilibrium counterpart which turns out to be dominated by nonuniversal contributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically show、scaling behavior、dynamic scaling variable、analytical evidence。；研究对象：量子费米子Kitaev线（quantum fermionic Kitaev wires）中，化学势临界淬火后的非平衡粒子密度标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在化学势瞬间淬火到临界点后，粒子密度与其临界值之差展现出非平衡标度行为，标度函数在θ→0极限下具有奇异性，这与粒子密度在淬火起始点的反常平衡标度行为相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在化学势瞬间淬火到临界点后，粒子密度与其临界值之差展现出非平衡标度行为，标度函数在θ→0极限下具有奇异性，这与粒子密度在淬火起始点的反常平衡标度行为相关。；创新点：提供了关于淬火后粒子密度差动态标度行为普遍出现的解析证据，并揭示了其与平衡态标度行为（受非普适贡献主导）的本质区别。摘要未突出说明与数值有限尺寸标度分析的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（analytically show），基于动态标度变量θ～t/ξ^z（t为淬火后时间，ξ为初始态长度尺度，z为动态临界指数），结合量子淬火协议与临界标度理论。

papers.title: The Physics of Topological Defects in Glasses
papers.abstract: Topological defects play a central role in the mechanical behavior of crystalline materials, yet their relevance to amorphous solids has only recently begun to emerge. Over the last few years, theoretical, computational, and experimental studies have revealed the presence of well-defined topological invariants in vibrational eigenmodes, non-affine displacement fields, and deformation-induced vector fields of glasses. These defects have been shown to correlate strongly with soft spots, localized plastic rearrangements, yielding, and shear-band formation, suggesting a new perspective on the microscopic origins of plasticity in disordered materials. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of recent developments in the rapidly growing field of topological defects in glasses. We discuss the underlying theoretical concepts, including Burgers vectors, non-affine plasticity, vibrational modes, and topological invariants, and review recent numerical and experimental advances. Finally, we assess the current achievements, limitations, and open questions, and discuss future directions toward a unified topological description of plasticity and mechanical failure in amorphous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论、计算与实验综述）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“theoretical, computational, and experimental studies”以及“review recent numerical and experimental advances”。；研究对象：玻璃（非晶固体）中的拓扑缺陷，具体涉及振动本征模、非仿射位移场、变形诱导矢量场中的拓扑不变量，以及这些缺陷与塑性变形、剪切带形成等力学行为的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻璃中已识别出具有明确拓扑不变量的缺陷，这些缺陷与软点、局域塑性重排、屈服和剪切带形成强相关，为理解无序材料塑性的微观起源提供了新视角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻璃中已识别出具有明确拓扑不变量的缺陷，这些缺陷与软点、局域塑性重排、屈服和剪切带形成强相关，为理解无序材料塑性的微观起源提供了新视角。；创新点：系统总结了近年来玻璃中拓扑缺陷这一新兴领域的发展，旨在推动建立非晶固体塑性与力学失效的统一拓扑描述。摘要未突出说明与以往综述相比的具体创新点。
papers.method_zh: 综述了理论概念（如伯格斯矢量、非仿射塑性、振动模式、拓扑不变量），以及近期的数值模拟和实验进展。摘要未具体说明实验或计算技术细节。

papers.title: Universal Extraction of Quantum Critical Exponents and Phase Transitions via Tailored Hilbert Space
papers.abstract: Finite-size scaling and the renormalization group form the central toolkit for analyzing quantum phase transitions (QPTs). In this Letter, we introduce a novel Hilbert-space tailoring scheme to probe quantum critical phenomena. Applied to the second-order QPT of the one-dimensional (1D) XY model, our method yields precise critical points and exponents on lattices containing merely 50 unit cells.
