papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碘（I₂）和体系密度共同控制磷的复合行为：低密度下原子磷占主导，加入I₂显著促进P-P复合并形成PₓIᵧ及瞬态SnₓPᵧI₂化合物；高密度下形成更大Pₓ团簇及三元SnₓPᵧI₂化合物，最终在最高密度下生成类似Hittorf磷的凝聚结构及碘稳定的类黑磷六元环，可能作为成核种子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碘（I₂）和体系密度共同控制磷的复合行为：低密度下原子磷占主导，加入I₂显著促进P-P复合并形成PₓIᵧ及瞬态SnₓPᵧI₂化合物；高密度下形成更大Pₓ团簇及三元SnₓPᵧI₂化合物，最终在最高密度下生成类似Hittorf磷的凝聚结构及碘稳定的类黑磷六元环，可能作为成核种子。；创新点：首次开发了针对P/Sn/I体系的反应力场，实现了对黑磷/磷烯化学气相传输合成中早期原子级过程的直接模拟，揭示了碘和密度对磷重组及成核前驱体形成的协同调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于ReaxFF反应力场的分子动力学模拟。力场参数通过训练涵盖键解离、角度和二面角分布、锡凝聚相状态方程及团簇形成能的量子力学数据集获得。

papers.title: Synchronization in coherently and dissipatively coupled spinor polariton time crystals
papers.abstract: The spinor degree of freedom associated to exciton-polariton condensates can spontaneously self-oscillate breaking time translation symmetry, thus showing a continuous time-crystal (CTC) behavior. An open question in such driven-dissipative and non-linear quantum open systems is what happens when CTCs are brought together to interact. Here we experimentally study polariton condensates in coupled traps, evidencing mutual induction and synchronization of the pseudospin temporal GHz dynamics in the CTC phase. The individual and relative orientation of the (limit cycle) precessing pseudospins can be tuned by the optical excitation power, displaying both ferro and anti-ferro dynamical configurations. We theoretically show that the exciton reservoir, and both the coherent and long-range dissipative inter-trap coupling, play important roles in the CTC dynamics. The investigation of time-broken symmetry is thus extended here to more complex non-hermitian systems opening the path to study self-sustained collective dynamics in lattices of non-linear quantum condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally study”和“theoretically show”，同时涉及实验观测与理论建模。；研究对象：激子-极化激元凝聚体中的自旋自由度（赝自旋）在连续时间晶体（CTC）相中的同步行为，具体为耦合陷阱中的极化子凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续时间晶体相中，耦合陷阱中的极化子凝聚体表现出赝自旋的相互诱导与GHz时间动力学同步，且可通过光激发功率调控自旋预旋的取向，实现铁磁与反铁磁两种动力学构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续时间晶体相中，耦合陷阱中的极化子凝聚体表现出赝自旋的相互诱导与GHz时间动力学同步，且可通过光激发功率调控自旋预旋的取向，实现铁磁与反铁磁两种动力学构型。；创新点：将时间平移对称性破缺的研究从单个连续时间晶体扩展到耦合系统，揭示了相干与耗散耦合在极化子时间晶体同步中的关键作用，为研究非线性量子凝聚体晶格中的自持集体动力学开辟了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用耦合陷阱中的极化子凝聚体，通过光学激发调控赝自旋的极限环进动；理论上考虑激子库、相干耦合以及长程耗散性阱间耦合的作用，对非厄米系统中的时间晶体动力学进行建模分析。

papers.title: Kohn-Luttinger like superconductivity in twisted bilayer graphene at large twist angles
papers.abstract: We predict that twisted bilayer graphene with large twist angle and small superlattice cell can be superconducting. Such a bilayer graphene can have a gap in the spectrum. This gap appears due to the hybridization of electrons moving in different layers with Fermi momenta close to the Dirac points which are equivalent to each other in the superlattice Brillouin zone. Small doping of the bilayer introduces charge carries having large density of states. We show that the screened Coulomb interaction is enough to stabilize superconducting state in the material. The symmetry of the order parameter is of the $d$-wave type. Application of the bias voltage increases the superconducting transition temperature. For realistic values of the model parameters the transition temperature can be as large as several hundreds of milikelvin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“We predict”、“We show”、“The symmetry of the order parameter is of the d-wave type”等，表明该工作基于理论模型进行计算和预测，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：大转角（large twist angle）下的扭曲双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene）。具体关注其在小超胞（small superlattice cell）情况下的超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测大转角的扭曲双层石墨烯可以出现d波对称性的超导态，其转变温度在合理模型参数下可达数百毫开尔文。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测大转角的扭曲双层石墨烯可以出现d波对称性的超导态，其转变温度在合理模型参数下可达数百毫开尔文。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于广泛研究的小转角魔角石墨烯（magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene），本工作的创新点在于指出在**大转角**（非魔角）条件下，扭曲双层石墨烯同样可以出现超导电性，且其机制为类似Kohn-Luttinger的库仑相互作用驱动，而非魔角下的平带效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与计算。具体包括：基于能带结构分析（提及狄拉克点附近费米动量的杂化导致能隙），通过计算态密度（large density of states）和屏蔽库仑相互作用（screened Coulomb interaction）来论证超导态的稳定性，并分析了偏压（bias voltage）对超导转变温度的影响。

papers.title: Step-Edge Passivation and Quantitative Raman Mapping of Transfer Quality in Aligned Graphene Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: The transfer of aligned graphene nanoribbons from metallic growth surfaces to device-compatible platforms remains a central bottleneck for nanoribbon electronics. Here, we investigate step-edge passivation of vicinal Au(788) by chevron-GNRs as a strategy to improve the transfer of aligned 9-armchair graphene nanoribbons. Scanning tunneling microscopy reveals that chevron-GNRs preferentially occupy step-edges, effectively acting as passivators that displace 9-AGNRs toward terrace centers, thereby altering their local growth configuration. To quantify transfer performance, we establish an automated large-area Raman analysis framework that enables pixel-wise classification based on the G mode and the radial breathing-like mode (RBLM). This approach provides a robust and scalable metric for assessing both transfer coverage and local ribbon integrity across macroscopic areas. Raman mapping uncovers strongly inhomogeneous transfer, characterized by extended regions with no detectable GNR signal and pronounced spatial variability in the RBLM-to-G intensity ratio. Transfer quality varies substantially across the sample series, with only a single high-yield outlier and most samples remaining well below 100% transfer yield. These results demonstrate that while chevron passivation locally modifies the growth configuration of 9-AGNRs on Au(788), it does not yet yield reproducible, high-quality transfer of intact aligned ribbons. The presented Raman-based analysis framework establishes a quantitative benchmark for the systematic optimization of GNR transfer strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy（扫描隧道显微镜）、Raman mapping（拉曼成像）、transfer（转移）。；研究对象：对齐的9-扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（9-AGNRs）在Au(788)台阶面上的生长与转移过程，以及chevron型GNRs对台阶边缘的钝化效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Chevron型GNRs优先占据Au(788)的台阶边缘，将9-AGNRs推向台面中心，从而改变其局部生长构型；但该钝化策略未能实现可重复的高质量转移，大多数样品的转移产率远低于100%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Chevron型GNRs优先占据Au(788)的台阶边缘，将9-AGNRs推向台面中心，从而改变其局部生长构型；但该钝化策略未能实现可重复的高质量转移，大多数样品的转移产率远低于100%。；创新点：提出并验证了利用chevron-GNRs对台阶边缘进行钝化以改善9-AGNRs转移的新策略；同时建立了基于拉曼成像的定量化、可扩展的转移质量评估方法，为GNR转移策略的系统优化提供了基准。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）用于观察GNRs在台阶边缘的占据行为；建立自动化大面积拉曼分析框架，基于G模和径向呼吸模（RBLM）进行像素级分类，定量评估转移覆盖率和局部纳米带完整性。

papers.title: Harnessing Josephson-Shapiro physics to verify interlayer exciton superfluidity
papers.abstract: Obtaining definitive evidence for zero-magnetic-field exciton superfluidity in electron-hole bilayers remains a longstanding challenge because the condensate is electrically neutral and its phase coherence is difficult to probe directly. We propose a direct test based on Shapiro steps in a Dayem-bridge excitonic Josephson junction. We predict clearly resolvable Shapiro plateaus in experimentally accessible current and voltage regimes for double-bilayer graphene and, in the low-density regime, double-layer transition-metal dichalcogenides. Moreover, by tuning the density across the BCS-BEC crossover we show that the Shapiro response acquires a distinct nonmonotonic evolution. This is determined by the nonmonotonic behavior of the healing length in the crossover from bosonic to fermionic excitations. Observation of these signatures would provide direct evidence of exciton superfluidity and establish exciton bilayers as a platform for neutral Josephson devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a direct test、We predict、We show。；研究对象：零磁场下电子-空穴双层体系中的激子超流现象，具体材料为双层石墨烯（double-bilayer graphene）和双层过渡金属硫族化合物（double-layer transition-metal dichalcogenides）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出通过Dayem桥激子约瑟夫森结中的Shapiro台阶来直接验证激子超流，并预言在可实验实现的电流和电压区间内能清晰分辨Shapiro平台；此外，通过调节密度跨越BCS-BEC渡越区，Shapiro响应呈现独特的非单调演化，可作为激子超流的直接证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出通过Dayem桥激子约瑟夫森结中的Shapiro台阶来直接验证激子超流，并预言在可实验实现的电流和电压区间内能清晰分辨Shapiro平台；此外，通过调节密度跨越BCS-BEC渡越区，Shapiro响应呈现独特的非单调演化，可作为激子超流的直接证据。；创新点：提出利用Shapiro台阶作为零磁场下激子超流的直接探测手段，并揭示BCS-BEC渡越区中愈合长度的非单调演化如何导致Shapiro响应的独特特征，从而将激子双层体系确立为中性约瑟夫森器件的平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于激子约瑟夫森结的Shapiro台阶物理，结合Dayem桥结构，分析电流-电压特性；通过调节载流子密度跨越BCS-BEC渡越区，计算并预测愈合长度（healing length）的非单调行为对Shapiro响应的决定作用。

papers.title: Wess-Zumino terms in 0+1 SU(N) superspin systems
papers.abstract: These notes present a self-contained introduction to Wess-Zumino (WZ) terms in quantum systems with $SU(N)$ symmetry, emphasizing the interplay between geometry, topology, and condensed-matter applications. We begin with the $SU(2)$ spin coherent-state path integral, where the Berry phase appears as a WZ term encoding the symplectic structure of the Bloch sphere. This example is then used to introduce the geometric origin of topological terms, their relation to integral cohomology classes, and the role of Berry curvature as the first Chern class of the canonical $U(1)$ bundle. We next discuss physical realizations in which such geometric terms affect dynamics, including adiabatic Berry phases and geometric quantum noise in magnetic quantum dots. A substantial part of the notes is devoted to the condensed-matter motivation for higher $SU(N)$ symmetries, covering $SU(N)$ Heisenberg models, $SU(4)$ spin-orbital and spin-pseudospin systems, multipolar exchange interactions, and higher-spin multipolar orders. Finally, we develop the 0+1-dimensional $SU(N)$ superspin coherent-state construction, identify the phase space with $CP^{N-1}$, and derive explicit local WZ terms for $SU(3)$ and $SU(4)$. The appendices provide algebraic dictionaries connecting the abstract superspin language with concrete physical embeddings, including multipolar generator bases and several useful $SU(4)$ parametrizations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：self-contained introduction、coherent-state path integral、geometric origin、derivation。；研究对象：具有SU(N)对称性的0+1维量子系统，特别是超自旋体系中的Wess-Zumino项，以及其在凝聚态物理中的应用，包括SU(2)自旋系统、SU(4)自旋-轨道和自旋-赝自旋系统、多极交换相互作用等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统阐述了Wess-Zumino项在SU(N)量子系统中的几何与拓扑起源，并给出了SU(3)和SU(4)超自旋相干态构造中显式的局域WZ项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统阐述了Wess-Zumino项在SU(N)量子系统中的几何与拓扑起源，并给出了SU(3)和SU(4)超自旋相干态构造中显式的局域WZ项。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用相干态路径积分方法，从SU(2)自旋的Berry相位出发，引入拓扑项的几何起源及其与积分上同调类的关系，并推广到0+1维SU(N)超自旋相干态构造，将相空间识别为CP^{N-1}流形。

papers.title: Universal Interatomic Potentials as Configuration-Space Generators for One-Shot and Iterative Fine-Tuning of Ab Initio-Accurate Material-Specific Models
papers.abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are rapidly becoming general-purpose tools for atomistic simulation, but their role in quantitative materials modeling when reactive events are involved remains unsettled. We compare five universal MLIPs across seven chemically diverse systems and find that strong performance on standard benchmarks does not guarantee accurate predictions of target observables. In particular, zero-shot models do not reliably reproduce reactive, transport, or high-barrier processes, exemplified here in particular by the sulfur-vacancy jump in MoS$_2$. We therefore propose a practical alternative: universal MLIPs are used to generate long molecular dynamics trajectories, the resulting configurations are sub-sampled and relabeled with DFT, and material-specific MLIPs are subsequently trained or fine-tuned on the resulting first-principles datasets. This workflow converts universal models into efficient configuration-space generators while retaining ab initio reference labels for training. Across the tested systems, $2{,}000$ DFT-recalculated structures are often sufficient to obtain accurate fine-tuned or trained-from-scratch models. For the most challenging case, iterative self-training progressively refines the sampled configuration space and recovers the DFT MoS$_2$ potential energy profile with only $600$ first-principles calculations in total. The resulting workflow enables the generation of $1$ ns ab initio-quality trajectories - including training data generation and model creation - within three days.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)”、“DFT”、“molecular dynamics trajectories”等计算与模拟方法关键词。；研究对象：论文研究了多种化学体系（共七种），重点以MoS₂中的硫空位跳跃（sulfur-vacancy jump）为例，涉及反应、输运及高势垒过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在标准基准测试中表现良好，但无法可靠预测涉及反应、输运或高势垒过程的目标可观测量；通过将通用MLIP作为构型空间生成器，结合DFT重新标记并微调或从头训练材料专用MLIP，可在少量DFT计算（如2000个结构）下获得高精度模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）在标准基准测试中表现良好，但无法可靠预测涉及反应、输运或高势垒过程的目标可观测量；通过将通用MLIP作为构型空间生成器，结合DFT重新标记并微调或从头训练材料专用MLIP，可在少量DFT计算（如2000个结构）下获得高精度模型。；创新点：提出将通用MLIP作为高效构型空间生成器，而非直接用于定量预测，从而在保留DFT参考标签的前提下，以极少的从头算计算量（如MoS₂仅需600个DFT计算）实现高精度材料专用模型的构建与迭代优化。
papers.method_zh: 使用五种通用MLIP进行零样本预测，并对比其性能；提出工作流：用通用MLIP生成长分子动力学轨迹，对构型进行子采样并用DFT重新标记，然后基于这些第一性原理数据集训练或微调材料专用MLIP。对于最具挑战性的体系，采用迭代自训练方法逐步优化构型空间。

papers.title: Coupling Heterarchical Granular Dynamics and Computational Fluid Dynamics
papers.abstract: Granular flows in ambient fluids exhibit grain-size-dependent segregation, which is difficult to capture efficiently with existing models, especially in large-scale systems involving more than a million grains. We develop a two-way coupled framework that integrates heterarchical granular dynamics (HGD) with a fluid-fraction-weighted incompressible Navier-Stokes solver. This heterarchical granular-fluid dynamics (HGFD) model extends a previous HGD model for quasi-static deformations by introducing inertial, force-balance-driven particle velocities and consistent fluid-solid momentum exchange. The coupling between the inertial HGD and the fluid solver is performed using a staggered explicit sequential scheme and co-located Eulerian fields. The framework is evaluated against experimental data of (i) single-particle settling to verify inertial relaxation, (ii) hindered settling to reproduce concentration-dependent settling and vertical size stratification, and (iii) representative cases covering three reported segregation types to assess regime sensitivity. These results establish HGFD as an efficient and consistent approach for simulating fluid-coupled granular segregation dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：two-way coupled framework、computational fluid dynamics、model、simulation。；研究对象：颗粒-流体两相流中的颗粒沉降与粒度分选（segregation）动力学，特别是环境流体中颗粒尺寸依赖的分选行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种将异质颗粒动力学（HGD）与流体分数加权不可压Navier-Stokes求解器双向耦合的框架（HGFD），能够高效且一致地模拟流体耦合的颗粒分选动力学，并在单颗粒沉降、受阻沉降及三种典型分选类型中与实验数据吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种将异质颗粒动力学（HGD）与流体分数加权不可压Navier-Stokes求解器双向耦合的框架（HGFD），能够高效且一致地模拟流体耦合的颗粒分选动力学，并在单颗粒沉降、受阻沉降及三种典型分选类型中与实验数据吻合。；创新点：将原本用于准静态变形的HGD模型扩展至惯性流动状态，并实现了与流体求解器的双向耦合，从而能够高效模拟包含超过百万颗粒的大尺度系统中的流体耦合颗粒分选动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用异质颗粒动力学（HGD）与流体分数加权不可压Navier-Stokes求解器的双向耦合框架。HGD部分引入了基于惯性、力平衡驱动的颗粒速度及一致的流固动量交换；耦合采用交错显式顺序方案和共位欧拉场实现。

papers.title: High Throughput Analysis of Nanobeam Electron Diffraction Datasets using Unsupervised Clustering
papers.abstract: If disk detection is applied to nanobeam electron diffraction datasets, then the results are effectively a list of vectors describing the position of every diffraction peak in real and reciprocal space. This is the natural territory for the application of clustering algorithms, and they are shown to be highly effective at decomposing such datasets and automating imaging and analysis. Examples are shown in both polycrystalline and single crystal (with precipitates) systems. Additionally, automated separation of amorphous or deeply nanocrystalline components is also found to be possible allowing composite images of both amorphous and crystalline components in partially crystallised samples to be easily and automatically generated. These advances promise to increase throughput in atomic structure analysis with nanobeam diffraction, and also make finding minor components much easier. They can also serve as a preliminary step towards more detailed crystallographic or crystal size/shape distribution analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“nanobeam electron diffraction datasets”（纳米束电子衍射数据集）、“disk detection”（盘检测）、“clustering algorithms”（聚类算法）应用于实验数据。；研究对象：多晶和单晶（含析出相）体系，以及部分结晶样品中的非晶/纳米晶组分。具体材料摘要未明确说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 聚类算法能够高效分解纳米束电子衍射数据集，自动生成成像和分析结果，并实现非晶与晶态组分的自动分离，从而提升原子结构分析的吞吐量并简化次要组分的发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：聚类算法能够高效分解纳米束电子衍射数据集，自动生成成像和分析结果，并实现非晶与晶态组分的自动分离，从而提升原子结构分析的吞吐量并简化次要组分的发现。；创新点：将聚类算法系统性地应用于纳米束电子衍射数据，实现了非晶/纳米晶组分与晶态组分的自动分离，以及复合图像的自动生成，为后续更详细的晶体学或晶粒尺寸/形状分布分析提供了预处理步骤。摘要未突出说明与已有聚类方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用无监督聚类算法（unsupervised clustering）对纳米束电子衍射（nanobeam electron diffraction）数据进行处理，首先通过盘检测（disk detection）提取每个衍射峰在实空间和倒易空间的位置向量，再对向量列表进行聚类分析。

papers.title: Rotating Zeeman field as a tool for Majorana zero mode detection in topological superconducting wire
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that analysis of the spin polarization of a quantum dot (QD) attached to the topological wire can provide valuable insights into Majorana zero mode (MZM) formation and topological phase transition. Detection is realized by rotation of the Zeeman field in the wire, while retaining the Zeeman field direction in the dot intact. In the presence of Majorana mode, the effective QD spin polarization at Fermi energy changes significantly when the direction of the Zeeman field in the wire changes from parallel to perpendicular to the wire axis. It can be opposed to the wire in its trivial state, when spin polarization remains practically constant while the magnetic field is rotated. Similar unaltered spin polarization is observed when QD spin sub-level at Fermi energy mimics MZM. Moreover, the characteristic non-linear dependence of the spin polarization on the magnetic field magnitude at its critical value identifies a topological phase transition in the wire. This feature is observed independently on the coupling strength of the wire to the dot and the angle of the Zeeman field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”“analysis”“observed”等描述理论分析与数值模拟的词汇，未提及实验设备或样品制备。；研究对象：拓扑超导纳米线中的马约拉纳零模（MZM）检测，具体体系为连接有量子点（QD）的拓扑超导纳米线，通过旋转塞曼场方向来研究量子点自旋极化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过旋转纳米线中的塞曼场方向（从平行于线轴变为垂直于线轴），可观察到量子点费米能级处自旋极化的显著变化，这一特征可用于区分马约拉纳零模存在与否，并识别拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过旋转纳米线中的塞曼场方向（从平行于线轴变为垂直于线轴），可观察到量子点费米能级处自旋极化的显著变化，这一特征可用于区分马约拉纳零模存在与否，并识别拓扑相变。；创新点：提出利用旋转塞曼场方向而非仅改变磁场大小来检测马约拉纳零模，并发现自旋极化在临界磁场处的非线性依赖关系可作为拓扑相变的判据，且该特征对量子点-纳米线耦合强度及塞曼场角度不敏感。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟：构建拓扑超导纳米线-量子点耦合模型，通过改变纳米线中塞曼场方向（保持量子点塞曼场方向不变），计算并分析量子点费米能级处的自旋极化随磁场方向与大小的变化关系。

papers.title: Toward in-situ/operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy and electrochemical characterization of solid oxide fuel cells
papers.abstract: The focus of the present work is the development of specialized experimental instrumentation compatible with synchrotron characterization for in-situ and operando symmetric intermediate temperature solid oxide fuel cells (IT-SOFC) studies at maximum temperatures of 800 C , exposed to reducing and oxidizing atmospheres, using fluorescence X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) measurements in combination with electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) in the multipurpose Quati beamline at CNPEM/SIRIUS synchrotron facility [1]. Symmetric IT-SOFC are gaining importance due to their structural simplicity, as they allow for the use of identical materials on both sides of the fuel cell electrolyte; the anode, and the cathode [ 2,3 ]. The symmetric configuration opens new opportunities for fundamental research of electrode materials and improves the versatility of SOFC electrochemical devices [2,3].
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“development of specialized experimental instrumentation”、“synchrotron characterization”、“in-situ and operando studies”、“X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) measurements”、“electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS)”。；研究对象：对称型中温固体氧化物燃料电池（IT-SOFC）及其电极材料。具体涉及在还原和氧化气氛下，对电池进行原位/操作态表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。该工作主要聚焦于开发一套与同步辐射兼容的专用实验仪器，用于在最高800°C下对对称型IT-SOFC进行原位/操作态X射线吸收光谱（XAS）与电化学阻抗谱（EIS）联合表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。该工作主要聚焦于开发一套与同步辐射兼容的专用实验仪器，用于在最高800°C下对对称型IT-SOFC进行原位/操作态X射线吸收光谱（XAS）与电化学阻抗谱（EIS）联合表征。；创新点：开发了与同步辐射表征兼容的专用实验仪器，实现了在高温（最高800°C）和可控气氛下，对对称型IT-SOFC进行原位/操作态的XAS与EIS联合表征。对称型电池结构简化了电极材料的基础研究。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：荧光X射线吸收光谱（XAS）测量、电化学阻抗谱（EIS）测量。实验平台为巴西CNPEM/SIRIUS同步辐射光源的Quati多功能光束线。样品为对称型中温固体氧化物燃料电池（IT-SOFC），可在还原和氧化气氛下工作。

papers.title: Unconventional topological Hall response and anisotropic magnetotransport properties of a helical magnet EuAuAs
papers.abstract: Topological magnets with nontrivial spin texture have attracted considerable interest because they display a rich spectrum of emergent quantum phenomena. Here, we present a combined experimental and theoretical investigation of the magnetic and magnetotransport properties of EuAuAs, an antiferromagnet with Néel temperature ($T_\mathrm{N}$) $\sim$ 6 K. The temperature and magnetic field dependence of electrical resistivity and magnetization demonstrate that the charge transport in EuAuAs is strongly influenced by the spin configuration of local Eu moments. Below $T_\mathrm{N}$, both longitudinal magnetoresistance (LMR) and transverse magnetoresistance (TMR) are positive at low fields but large and negative at high fields. With increasing temperature, TMR becomes positive above 60 K, whereas LMR remains negative up to 100 K. The low-field positive LMR and TMR originate from weak antilocalization (WAL). The WAL contribution in TMR is well captured by the Hikami-Larkin-Nagaoka model, whereas the LMR data are described by a generalized Altshuler-Aronov framework. Moreover, we observe a giant topological Hall effect arising from the scalar spin chirality, which is further supported by the helical magnetic structure obtained from the ab-initio calculations. The observed anisotropy in longitudinal resistivity and magnetoresistance underscores the very nature of the Fermi surface of the EuAuAs, as confirmed by first-principles calculations. These results establish EuAuAs as a unique platform for exploring the interplay between electronic structure and noncoplanar spin texture in a centrosymmetric helical magnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and theoretical investigation”，包括电输运测量、磁化测量以及第一性原理计算（ab-initio calculations / first-principles calculations）。；研究对象：螺旋磁体EuAuAs，一种奈尔温度约6 K的反铁磁材料，重点研究其磁性与磁输运性质，特别是非共面自旋织构导致的拓扑霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在EuAuAs中观测到由标量自旋手性引起的巨大拓扑霍尔效应，以及纵向和横向磁电阻在低场下的正贡献（源于弱反局域化）和高场下的大负贡献；同时发现纵向电阻率和磁电阻的显著各向异性，反映了费米面的本征性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在EuAuAs中观测到由标量自旋手性引起的巨大拓扑霍尔效应，以及纵向和横向磁电阻在低场下的正贡献（源于弱反局域化）和高场下的大负贡献；同时发现纵向电阻率和磁电阻的显著各向异性，反映了费米面的本征性质。；创新点：在中心对称螺旋磁体EuAuAs中同时实现了对弱反局域化、拓扑霍尔效应和磁输运各向异性的系统研究，揭示了电子结构与非共面自旋织构之间的相互作用，为探索此类体系提供了独特平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：测量电阻率、纵向磁电阻（LMR）和横向磁电阻（TMR）随温度与磁场的变化，以及磁化强度；理论上：采用第一性原理计算（ab-initio calculations）获得螺旋磁结构，并用Hikami-Larkin-Nagaoka模型拟合TMR中的弱反局域化贡献，用广义Altshuler-Aronov框架描述LMR数据。

papers.title: Reduced-Order Modelling of Defect Transport using Surrogate Kinetics: Application to U$_x$Pu$_ {1-x}$N
papers.abstract: Defect transport in chemically disordered materials is a difficult phenomenon to model since migration energetics depend strongly on the local chemical environment, producing a distribution of transition barriers that cannot be exhaustively enumerated. Here, we develop a reduced-order approach to modelling defect diffusion in compositionally complex materials using environment-dependent surrogate kinetics. Migration energetics for actinide vacancies, nitride vacancies, and actinide-nitride divacancies in U$_x$Pu$_{1-x}$N are generated using the Hop-Decorate workflow across thousands of chemical configurations. These data are distilled into compact surrogate functions that predict migration barriers and energy differences from simple descriptors based on local coordination counts. The surrogate models reproduce the atomistic dataset with low error and enable efficient evaluation of migration rates during lattice kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. Long-time diffusivities computed across temperature and composition reveal strongly non-linear behaviour arising from two dominant mechanisms: species-controlled migration on the actinide sublattice and environment-dependent trapping on the nitride sublattice. Although demonstrated for U$_x$Pu$_{1-x}$N the framework provides a general and computationally efficient approach for modelling defect transport in chemically disordered materials and for integrating atomistic kinetics into higher-scale simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：reduced-order modelling、surrogate kinetics、lattice kinetic Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：化学无序材料（UₓPu₁₋ₓN）中的缺陷输运现象，具体包括锕系空位、氮化物空位以及锕系-氮化物双空位的迁移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 缺陷扩散表现出强非线性行为，主要源于两种机制：锕系亚晶格上的物种控制迁移，以及氮化物亚晶格上的环境依赖陷阱效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：缺陷扩散表现出强非线性行为，主要源于两种机制：锕系亚晶格上的物种控制迁移，以及氮化物亚晶格上的环境依赖陷阱效应。；创新点：提出了一种基于环境依赖替代动力学（surrogate kinetics）的降阶建模框架，能够高效处理化学无序材料中因局域化学环境变化导致的迁移势垒分布问题，并实现了从原子尺度动力学到更高尺度模拟的集成。
papers.method_zh: 采用Hop-Decorate工作流生成数千种化学构型下的迁移能数据，并构建基于局域配位数的紧凑替代函数（surrogate functions）来预测迁移势垒和能量差，进而用于晶格动力学蒙特卡洛（lattice kinetic Monte Carlo）模拟。

papers.title: Angular-time evolution and edge-spin dynamics in the Haldane phase of the S=1 bilinear-biquadratic chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the angular-time evolution -- a parameter-time evolution generated by the entanglement Hamiltonian -- for the bipartitioned ground state of the S=1 bilinear-biquadratic chain under the open boundary condition with the up edge spin. Using a matrix-product-state representation of the ground-state wavefunction, we calculate the angular-time spin correlation functions $\langle S_n^{α}(τ)S_{n'}^{α}(0)\rangle$ in the Haldane phase, and extract its dominant oscillation mode attributed to the nearly two-fold-degenerate entanglement spectrum associated with the $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry. We also compute the effective edge-spin dynamics under a uniform magnetic field applied to the system part and numerically verify its correspondence to the dominant angular-time mode by precisely comparing the subsystem-size dependence of their amplitudes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：matrix-product-state representation（矩阵乘积态表示）、计算spin correlation functions（自旋关联函数）、数值验证。；研究对象：S=1 bilinear-biquadratic chain（S=1双线性-双二次链）在开放边界条件下、具有上边缘自旋的Haldane相中的角时间演化（angular-time evolution）和边缘自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Haldane相中，角时间自旋关联函数的主导振荡模式源于与Z₂×Z₂对称性相关的近二重简并纠缠谱；该模式与系统部分在均匀磁场下的有效边缘自旋动力学相对应，并通过子系统尺寸依赖性的精确比较得到数值验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Haldane相中，角时间自旋关联函数的主导振荡模式源于与Z₂×Z₂对称性相关的近二重简并纠缠谱；该模式与系统部分在均匀磁场下的有效边缘自旋动力学相对应，并通过子系统尺寸依赖性的精确比较得到数值验证。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）表示基态波函数，计算角时间自旋关联函数⟨S_n^α(τ)S_{n'}^α(0)⟩；通过纠缠哈密顿量生成参数时间演化（角时间演化）；数值计算系统部分在均匀磁场下的边缘自旋动力学，并比较子系统尺寸依赖性。

papers.title: Fingerprints of an Imbert-Fedorov-like effect in the tunneling transmission of Rarita-Schwinger semi-metals
papers.abstract: We study tunneling through a square barrier in a rotationally symmetric Rarita-Schwinger semi-metal and identify fingerprints of an Imbert-Fedorov-like effect in the tunneling transmission. The problem is intrinsically multichannel at all energies because there exist two propagating sectors with spin projections $m=1/2$ and $m=3/2$. We derive the transmission amplitudes analytically and compare the single-channel and coherent mixed-incidence cases in the two channels. Interestingly, we observe that tunneling at high energy shows a bias towards scattering into spin projection $3/2$ contributions. For single-channel injection, we find that the transmission remains symmetric under a mirror transformation of the incident angle. In contrast, for the coherent superposition, we find a directional asymmetry in the transmission probability $T(k_y)\neq T(-k_y)$. Importantly, this effect does not originate from an anisotropy of the dispersion. Instead, it arises from the phase structure of the multicomponent scattering states. The two spin projection sectors exhibit different scattering and barrier-propagation phases, which enter as interference terms when both channels appear as a coherent superposition. This interference term is identified as the cause of the broken mirror symmetry. We therefore discover an analog of the Imbert-Fedorov effect, at the level of interface-induced phase differences between internal wave components. Our result demonstrates that asymmetric tunneling can already occur in transport experiments, even in an idealized, isotropic multiband system, and should therefore not be automatically attributed solely to explicit band anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We study”“We derive”“We observe”等理论推导与分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：旋转对称的Rarita-Schwinger半金属中的方势垒隧穿输运现象，具体关注类似Imbert-Fedorov效应的隧穿特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在旋转对称的Rarita-Schwinger半金属中，即使没有能带各向异性，多通道相干叠加也会导致隧穿概率出现方向不对称性（T(k_y)≠T(-k_y)），这一效应源于不同自旋投影通道（m=1/2和m=3/2）在散射和势垒传播中积累的相位差产生的干涉项，是Imbert-Fedorov效应在隧穿输运中的类比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在旋转对称的Rarita-Schwinger半金属中，即使没有能带各向异性，多通道相干叠加也会导致隧穿概率出现方向不对称性（T(k_y)≠T(-k_y)），这一效应源于不同自旋投影通道（m=1/2和m=3/2）在散射和势垒传播中积累的相位差产生的干涉项，是Imbert-Fedorov效应在隧穿输运中的类比。；创新点：首次在旋转对称（各向同性）的多带系统中发现隧穿方向不对称性，证明该不对称性并非必然源于能带各向异性，而是由多通道散射态的相位结构导致，为Imbert-Fedorov效应在凝聚态输运中的实现提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导了方势垒隧穿的透射振幅，对比了单通道注入与两通道相干混合入射两种情况下的透射特性，分析了透射概率对入射角度的镜像对称性。

papers.title: Universality of dimensional crossovers in topological insulators
papers.abstract: We investigate dimensional crossovers in minimal tight-binding models of three-dimensional (3D) topological insulators subject to geometric confinement. While thin films are commonly understood to host a crossover from a 3D strong topological insulator to a two-dimensional (2D) quantum spin Hall phase via hybridization of surface states, we demonstrate that this picture is incomplete once bulk confinement effects and boundary termination are fully taken into account. Using lattice models, we show that reducing the system size induces a strongly non-monotonic dependence of the topology on thickness and microscopic parameters, leading to a sequence of topological phase transitions that is highly sensitive to surface termination. In particular, we find a cascade of dimensional reduction from a 3D topological insulator to a 2D quantum spin Hall phase and ultimately to a one-dimensional phase consisting of end states of Kramers pairs protected by inversion symmetry. Remarkably, we show that both the 2D and 1D topological phases can emerge even when the corresponding 3D bulk phase is topologically trivial. Our results reveal an unexpected universality in the phase diagrams of 3D-to-2D and 2D-to-1D crossovers, pointing toward a unified framework for topology under dimensional reduction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：tight-binding models、lattice models、phase diagrams。；研究对象：三维拓扑绝缘体在几何受限（如薄膜）下的维度交叉现象，具体包括从三维强拓扑绝缘体到二维量子自旋霍尔相、再到一维Kramers对端态相的拓扑相变序列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在考虑体态受限效应和边界终止后，拓扑绝缘体的维度交叉并非简单的从三维到二维的平滑过渡，而是呈现强非单调的拓扑相变序列，且对表面终止高度敏感；此外，即使三维体态是拓扑平庸的，二维和一维拓扑相仍可能出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在考虑体态受限效应和边界终止后，拓扑绝缘体的维度交叉并非简单的从三维到二维的平滑过渡，而是呈现强非单调的拓扑相变序列，且对表面终止高度敏感；此外，即使三维体态是拓扑平庸的，二维和一维拓扑相仍可能出现。；创新点：揭示了三维到二维及二维到一维维度交叉中相图的普适性，并指出在三维体态拓扑平庸时仍可涌现低维拓扑相，这一发现挑战了传统对维度交叉的简单理解。摘要未突出说明与具体材料或实验验证的关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于最小紧束缚模型（minimal tight-binding models）的晶格模型计算，通过系统尺寸和微观参数的调控分析拓扑相图。

papers.title: Nonlinear Static Screening of Positive Charges in an Electron Gas: Contact Hartree Energy
papers.abstract: Electron screening of positive charges in metals is most strongly nonlinear in the static near-field regime. We revisit screening of a static single protonic charge in a homogeneous electron gas, focusing on the induced density and the contact Hartree energy $U_{\text{H}}(0)$. Although evaluated at the impurity position, $U_{\text{H}}(0)$ is not purely local: our formulation makes it explicit as a nonlocal quantity set by a radial moment of the full induced density, applicable to both linear-response and nonlinear density-functional-theory (DFT) descriptions. We compare Thomas--Fermi, Lindhard/random-phase-approximation, and local-field-corrected dielectric models with nonlinear DFT benchmarks. The Estreicher--Meier local-density-approximation (LDA) parametrization reproduces the contact Hartree energy from our direct LDA calculations and the self-consistent results of Almbladh \emph{et al.} [\href{https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.14.2250}{Phys. Rev. B \textbf{14}, 2250 (1976)}]. This validates the unified $U_{\text{H}}(0)$ implementation, separates the hydrogenic density profile from non-negligible Friedel oscillations, and provides a compact nonlinear reference for linear-response theory. Testing modern local-field factors, the Corradini--Del Sole--Onida--Palummo and Kaplan--Kukkonen parametrizations yield indistinguishable contact screening despite differing near $q\simeq 2k_F$. We also analyze Yukawa, hydrogenic, and Hulthén screened Coulomb potentials via a variable-phase scattering formulation constrained by the Friedel sum rule; these give a useful phase-shift representation of static screening but cannot alone reproduce the nonlinear DFT contact Hartree energy. The results establish a one-center nonlinear screening benchmark for proton impurities in jellium and clarify the baseline needed before treating two-center screening relevant to low-energy fusion in condensed matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：revisit、formulation、density-functional-theory、dielectric models、phase-shift formulation）；研究对象：均匀电子气中单个静态质子电荷的非线性静态屏蔽，以及接触哈特里能（contact Hartree energy）U_H(0)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 接触哈特里能U_H(0)本质上是一个由全诱导密度径向矩决定的非局域量，而非纯局域量；Estreicher–Meier局域密度近似（LDA）参数化能复现直接LDA计算和Almbladh等人的自洽结果，验证了统一的U_H(0)实现，并提供了非线性屏蔽的基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：接触哈特里能U_H(0)本质上是一个由全诱导密度径向矩决定的非局域量，而非纯局域量；Estreicher–Meier局域密度近似（LDA）参数化能复现直接LDA计算和Almbladh等人的自洽结果，验证了统一的U_H(0)实现，并提供了非线性屏蔽的基准。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Thomas–Fermi、Lindhard/随机相位近似（RPA）以及局域场修正的介电模型，并与非线性密度泛函理论（DFT）基准进行比较；同时利用受Friedel求和规则约束的变分相散射公式分析Yukawa、类氢和Hulthén屏蔽库仑势。

papers.title: Tomography of Transport Pathways in Selective-Area-Grown Nanowires Using Angle-Resolved Conductance Fluctuations
papers.abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of carriers is important for interpreting transport in nanoscale devices. Here, we apply conductance fluctuation tomography to planar selective-area-grown InAs nanowires in both normal-normal and normal-superconductor device geometries. By tracking the evolution of conductance-interference features as a function of magnetic-field strength and orientation, we extract information about the geometry of phase-coherent transport pathways. Using theory to distinguish between bulk-dominated transport, coherent near-surface transport across facets, and transport confined to individual facets. The measurements are consistent with transport dominated by a near-surface accumulation layer in InAs. Devices with normal contacts show behavior consistent with coherent transport across the nanowire apex, whereas hybrid normal-superconductor devices exhibit signatures of more facet-dependent transport. These results demonstrate how universal conductance fluctuations can be used as a tomographic probe of phase-coherent transport pathways in semiconductor nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（“应用电导涨落断层扫描技术”）、器件制备（“平面选区生长InAs纳米线”）以及测量结果（“测量结果与...一致”）。；研究对象：平面选区生长的InAs纳米线中的相相干输运路径。具体研究了正常-正常（normal-normal）和正常-超导（normal-superconductor）两种器件构型下的载流子空间分布和输运几何结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电导涨落断层扫描技术，发现InAs纳米线的输运主要由近表面积累层主导。正常接触器件表现为跨越纳米线顶点的相干输运，而正常-超导混合器件则显示出更依赖于特定晶面的输运特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电导涨落断层扫描技术，发现InAs纳米线的输运主要由近表面积累层主导。正常接触器件表现为跨越纳米线顶点的相干输运，而正常-超导混合器件则显示出更依赖于特定晶面的输运特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该方法的核心创新在于将普遍存在的电导涨落（Universal Conductance Fluctuations）作为一种断层扫描探针，用于解析半导体纳米结构中相相干输运路径的几何信息，而不仅仅是测量其幅度。
papers.method_zh: 电导涨落断层扫描术（Conductance fluctuation tomography）。具体通过测量电导干涉特征随磁场强度和方向的变化，并结合理论区分体主导输运、近表面相干输运以及单晶面限制输运。

papers.title: Deviance from a pink noise regime in the temporal organization of semantic relations in psychosis
papers.abstract: The notion of pink noise refers to 'scale-invariant' temporal dynamics, where fluctuations exhibit similar statistical structure across time scales. Departures from a regime associated with such scale-free organization toward uncorrelated 'white' noise or overly persistent 'brown' noise have been widely identified as markers of pathology across physiological and cognitive domains. Whether comparable alterations characterize the temporal organization of language remains largely unexplored. We address this question in the domain of psychosis, where language anomalies are pervasively documented. Specifically, we apply detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) to quantify temporal scaling in BERT-derived continuous cosine-similarity time series capturing trajectories through semantic space, using clinical transcripts from patients and controls across three independent datasets. DFA scaling exponents were extracted to characterize the strength of long-range temporal correlations. Across all datasets, patients exhibited significantly elevated scaling exponents relative to controls, indicating abnormally strong long-range correlations with excessive persistence in semantic fluctuations. This temporal analysis opens a window into the multi-timescale organization of meaning as it unfolds in discourse. The results reveal a signature of altered temporal scaling in speech, consistent with deviations from criticality in physiological domains, paralleling known departures from criticality in brain function in psychosis and suggesting possible links between these two domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确使用了“detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA)”这一计算方法对时间序列进行分析，并提取了“DFA scaling exponents”作为量化指标。；研究对象：语言在语义空间中的时间组织动力学，具体聚焦于精神疾病（psychosis）患者与健康对照者在自然语言产出中语义关系的时序波动特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精神疾病患者语言中语义波动的长程时间相关性异常增强，表现为过度持久的“棕色噪声”特征，偏离了健康语言中接近“粉红噪声”的标度不变组织模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精神疾病患者语言中语义波动的长程时间相关性异常增强，表现为过度持久的“棕色噪声”特征，偏离了健康语言中接近“粉红噪声”的标度不变组织模式。；创新点：首次将生理与认知领域中偏离粉红噪声（标度不变性）作为病理标志的概念，系统性地拓展到语言的时间组织分析中，揭示了精神疾病中语义动态的异常标度行为，并暗示其与已知的脑功能临界性偏离之间存在潜在联系。
papers.method_zh: 使用去趋势波动分析（DFA）对BERT模型导出的连续余弦相似度时间序列进行标度指数提取，以量化语义轨迹中长程时间相关性的强度。数据来自三个独立数据集的精神疾病患者与健康对照者的临床转录文本。

papers.title: Strongly anisotropic Rytova-Keldysh interaction and the ground state of 2D excitons
papers.abstract: The classic Rytova-Keldysh potential describes the non-local dielectric screening of Coulomb interactions in ultrathin two-dimensional (2D) materials. Recently, the corresponding potential for arbitrary in-plane anisotropy was derived in integral form, with numerical studies suggesting that an effective isotropic approximation remains robust for highly directional systems. In this paper we provide the analytical foundation for these observations by mapping the complete spatial landscape of the strongly anisotropic Rytova-Keldysh interaction. By applying the method of steepest descent and momentum-space coordinate scaling to the exact one-dimensional integral representation, we derive closed-form asymptotic expressions for the potential across all spatial regimes. We find that the intermediate-range screening exhibits a non-trivial amplitude scaling driven by the direction of weakest polarizability, while the short-range limit produces an anisotropic logarithmic well governed by the geometric mean of the principal polarizabilities. Finally, utilizing this short-range confinement, we implement an anisotropic Gaussian variational ansatz to solve the Wannier equation, providing a closed-form analytical expression for the exciton ground-state binding energy that explicitly captures the competition between the effective mass and dielectric tensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analytical foundation”“method of steepest descent”“closed-form asymptotic expressions”“variational ansatz”等理论推导和解析方法关键词。；研究对象：二维激子的基态，具体研究强各向异性Rytova-Keldysh相互作用下的激子束缚能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强各向异性Rytova-Keldysh势在中等距离的屏蔽由最弱极化方向主导，短程极限下形成由主极化率几何平均值决定的对数势阱；基于此短程势阱，给出了激子基态束缚能的闭合解析表达式，明确体现了有效质量张量与介电张量之间的竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强各向异性Rytova-Keldysh势在中等距离的屏蔽由最弱极化方向主导，短程极限下形成由主极化率几何平均值决定的对数势阱；基于此短程势阱，给出了激子基态束缚能的闭合解析表达式，明确体现了有效质量张量与介电张量之间的竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用最速下降法和动量空间坐标缩放对精确一维积分表示进行渐近分析，推导出各空间区域的闭合渐近表达式；利用短程势阱，采用各向异性高斯变分拟设求解Wannier方程。

papers.title: Spiral spin liquid resilient to quantization in the frustrated honeycomb antiferromagnet GdZnPO
papers.abstract: Frustrated magnets host strong quantum fluctuations that can suppress conventional magnetic order and give rise to exotic quantum phases such as spin liquids. In some cases, however, quantum fluctuations lift classical degeneracies and stabilize ordered states via an order-by-quantum-disorder mechanism. The spin-7/2 honeycomb antiferromagnet GdZnPO has recently been proposed as a spiral spin-liquid candidate arising from cooperative fluctuations among a subextensively degenerate manifold of spiral states. Here, we investigate the local magnetization and spin dynamics in GdZnPO using nuclear magnetic resonance. In an intermediate field regime between $\sim$3 T and the saturation field ($\sim$12 T), we observe a spatially uniform magnetization and persistent low-energy spin dynamics down to 0.033 K, with no detectable symmetry breaking, providing spectroscopic evidence for a spin-liquid state. At lower fields below $\sim$3 T, a weak stripe order emerges below $\sim$0.25 K; however, strong fluctuations persist, as indicated by a nearly temperature-independent and unusually large spin-lattice relaxation rate in the low-temperature limit. Our results demonstrate that spin-7/2 quantization weakly lifts the spiral degeneracy, stabilizing subtle magnetic order while preserving robust dynamics and spin-liquid phenomenology. These findings establish GdZnPO as a promising platform for exploring spin liquids in high-spin frustrated magnets down to the lowest accessible temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用核磁共振（nuclear magnetic resonance）进行测量，并报告了局域磁化、自旋动力学等实验观测结果。；研究对象：自旋-7/2 蜂窝状反铁磁体 GdZnPO，具体研究其螺旋自旋液体（spiral spin liquid）态及其在量子化效应下的稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中间磁场区域（~3 T 至饱和场 ~12 T），GdZnPO 表现出均匀磁化和持续的低能自旋动力学，直至 0.033 K 仍无对称性破缺，为自旋液体态提供了谱学证据；在更低磁场下（< ~3 T）虽出现弱条纹序，但强涨落依然存在，表明自旋-7/2 的量子化仅微弱地解除螺旋简并，稳定了微弱磁序的同时保留了自旋液体现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中间磁场区域（~3 T 至饱和场 ~12 T），GdZnPO 表现出均匀磁化和持续的低能自旋动力学，直至 0.033 K 仍无对称性破缺，为自旋液体态提供了谱学证据；在更低磁场下（< ~3 T）虽出现弱条纹序，但强涨落依然存在，表明自旋-7/2 的量子化仅微弱地解除螺旋简并，稳定了微弱磁序的同时保留了自旋液体现象。；创新点：首次在实验上证实高自旋（S=7/2）阻挫蜂窝状反铁磁体 GdZnPO 中存在螺旋自旋液体态，并揭示了量子化效应如何微弱地影响螺旋简并，从而在极低温下仍保持自旋液体行为与微弱磁序共存。
papers.method_zh: 核磁共振（NMR）技术，用于测量局域磁化（local magnetization）和自旋动力学（spin dynamics），特别是自旋-晶格弛豫率（spin-lattice relaxation rate）的温度与磁场依赖性。

papers.title: Scalable Physics-Inspired Transformers for Spin Glasses
papers.abstract: Efficient sampling of the Boltzmann distribution in frustrated spin glasses is central to statistical mechanics and combinatorial optimization. Despite advances in machine-learning-based approaches, two issues persist: limited understanding of why variational models fail to benefit from increased scale, unlike the monotonic scaling law of large language models; and high computational cost on large systems that negates advantages over classical sampling methods. Here, we develop a physics-inspired transformer with interpretable sparse attention and spin-tailored positional embeddings to address these challenges. By further leveraging FlashAttention for parallel ancestral sampling, it achieves up to two orders of magnitude speedup over vanilla variational autoregressive networks, enabling neural-network simulations of spin-glass systems to unprecedented sizes on a single GPU. It can resolve full probability distributions, free energies, and overlap statistics across temperatures, for Sherrington-Kirkpatrick and 2D or 3D Edwards-Anderson models, where existing machine-learning methods encounter limitations at certain temperatures. This framework thus establishes a scalable paradigm for frustrated spin-glass systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：efficient sampling、neural-network simulations、variational autoregressive networks、FlashAttention。；研究对象：阻挫自旋玻璃系统，具体包括Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型以及二维和三维Edwards-Anderson模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种可扩展的物理启发式Transformer模型，能够在单个GPU上对自旋玻璃系统进行前所未有的规模模拟，并在某些温度下解决了现有机器学习方法遇到的局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种可扩展的物理启发式Transformer模型，能够在单个GPU上对自旋玻璃系统进行前所未有的规模模拟，并在某些温度下解决了现有机器学习方法遇到的局限性。；创新点：通过引入物理启发的稀疏注意力和自旋定制的位置嵌入，解决了变分模型在规模增大时性能提升有限的问题，并大幅降低了大规模系统的计算成本，使得神经网络模拟能够达到前所未有的系统尺寸。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理启发式Transformer架构，包含可解释的稀疏注意力机制和针对自旋系统定制的位置嵌入；利用FlashAttention实现并行祖先采样，从而在计算速度上比传统变分自回归网络提升两个数量级。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic Phase Separation and Morphological Evolution in Chiral Active-Passive Mixtures
papers.abstract: The collective behavior of passive particles within chiral active matter has emerged as a significant area of soft matter research. However, most existing studies focus on systems where chirality is imposed by external torques rather than intrinsic activity. In this work, we study emergent dynamics in a suspension of active spinners and passive colloids by computing many-body hydrodynamic interactions via Ewald summation. By systematically exploring a broad range of area fractions and rotational velocities, we identify distinct phase-separation regimes sensitive to the system's kinematic parameters. Specifically, we report the emergence of unique structural morphologies, including the formation of passive particle vortices surrounding phase-separated active spinners and the development of large-scale active-passive bands. We characterize the underlying dynamics by analyzing the temporal evolution of characteristic length scales and the non-equilibrium velocity distributions of the passive particles. Our findings provide new insights into the role of long-range hydrodynamic couplings in governing the self-organization of non-equilibrium condensed matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computing many-body hydrodynamic interactions via Ewald summation（通过Ewald求和计算多体流体动力学相互作用）。；研究对象：手性活性-被动混合物中的流体动力学相分离与形态演化，具体为活性旋转粒子（active spinners）与被动胶体（passive colloids）组成的悬浮体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了依赖于系统运动学参数（面积分数和旋转速度）的不同相分离区域，并观察到独特的结构形态，包括被动粒子涡旋环绕相分离的活性旋转粒子，以及大尺度活性-被动条带的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了依赖于系统运动学参数（面积分数和旋转速度）的不同相分离区域，并观察到独特的结构形态，包括被动粒子涡旋环绕相分离的活性旋转粒子，以及大尺度活性-被动条带的形成。；创新点：区别于以往大多数研究通过外部扭矩施加手性的做法，本工作聚焦于内在活性（intrinsic activity）驱动的手性体系，揭示了长程流体动力学耦合在非平衡凝聚态物质自组织中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ewald求和方法计算多体流体动力学相互作用，系统扫描了广泛的面积分数和旋转速度参数空间，并通过分析特征长度的时间演化和被动粒子的非平衡速度分布来表征动力学。

papers.title: Coherent seeding and control of dynamical ferroelectricity by phonon anharmonicity
papers.abstract: Optical control of quantum materials has progressed along two separate directions: creating non-equilibrium states inaccessible at equilibrium, and coherently controlling ultrafast dynamics with multi-pulse protocols. Ferroelectricity is especially attractive in this context because its order parameter, macroscopic polarization, directly links inversion-symmetry breaking to functional response. Yet light-induced ferroelectricity has so far been confined to quantum paraelectrics near the ferroelectric instability, where critical fluctuations obscure the formation of a homogeneous ferroelectric state and complicate its deterministic coherent control. Unifying these capabilities -- preparing a symmetry-broken state and then coherently steering its functionality -- remains a central challenge. Here we show that intense terahertz excitation of a soft phonon mode induces a ferroelectric state in centrosymmetric PbTe, a thermoelectric material with strong lattice anharmonicity but no ferroelectric transition at finite temperature. The light-induced symmetry-broken state can be realized up to about 100 K, without relying on local dipolar fluctuations. Experiment and theory together reveal that terahertz-driven anharmonic coupling between degenerate transverse optical phonons underlies this ferroelectric induction. Furthermore, we demonstrate coherent amplification and suppression of the induced polarization via a double-pulse-excitation protocol. These results establish terahertz-driven anharmonic mode coupling as a general strategy for controlling mode-mediated functionalities in quantum materials, opening a route to ultrafast information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Experiment and theory together reveal...”，表明同时包含实验测量和理论分析。；研究对象：中心对称热电材料PbTe（碲化铅）中的光致动态铁电性，具体涉及太赫兹激发软声子模式诱导的对称性破缺态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称的PbTe中，通过强太赫兹场激发软声子模式，可诱导出铁电态（无需依赖局域偶极涨落），且该态可在高达约100 K的温度下实现；进一步通过双脉冲激发协议，实现了对诱导极化的相干放大与抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称的PbTe中，通过强太赫兹场激发软声子模式，可诱导出铁电态（无需依赖局域偶极涨落），且该态可在高达约100 K的温度下实现；进一步通过双脉冲激发协议，实现了对诱导极化的相干放大与抑制。；创新点：首次在非铁电体（无有限温度铁电相变）中通过太赫兹驱动的声子非谐耦合实现动态铁电性的相干产生与控制，将“制备对称性破缺态”与“相干操控其功能”统一起来，为超快信息处理开辟新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用强太赫兹脉冲激发软声子模式，并结合双脉冲激发协议；理论上通过分析太赫兹驱动的简并横光学声子之间的非谐耦合机制来解释铁电诱导现象。

papers.title: Interfacial-melt stability as a thermodynamic prerequisite for solid-state synthesis
papers.abstract: Computational materials discovery commonly ranks candidate materials by their thermodynamic stability on the formation energy convex hull, yet many predicted-stable phases resist synthesis. We propose that solid-state synthesizability through interfacial-melt-mediated routes requires an additional thermodynamic condition: the interfacial melt at the target composition must itself remain locally stable against spinodal decomposition. We demonstrate this in the classical Fe--B system, where thermodynamically stable FeB$_4$ has been reported under high-pressure synthesis but not in low-pressure synthesis attempts. Using melt--quench molecular dynamics driven by a fine-tuned machine-learning interatomic potential, we find that, at ambient pressure, the B-rich interfacial melt near the FeB$_4$ composition develops a concave free-energy landscape, signaling a demixing instability that is corroborated by the concentration--concentration structure factor and correlated with low-energy icosahedral and pentagonal-pyramidal boron motifs. Applied pressure introduces a convex $PV$ contribution that restores melt stability, consistent with the experimental synthesis boundary. Interfacial-melt stability, which atomistic simulations can assess via structure-factor divergence, is thus proposed as a practical thermodynamic screening descriptor of synthesizability for AI-assisted materials discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：melt–quench molecular dynamics、machine-learning interatomic potential、atomistic simulations、structure-factor divergence）；研究对象：固态合成中界面熔体的热力学稳定性，以Fe–B体系（特别是FeB₄相）为具体案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出界面熔体在目标组分下必须自身对旋节分解保持局部稳定，是固态合成可行性的额外热力学前提；在FeB₄中，常压下界面熔体因自由能曲面凹陷而失稳，施加压力可恢复其稳定性，与高压合成实验边界一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出界面熔体在目标组分下必须自身对旋节分解保持局部稳定，是固态合成可行性的额外热力学前提；在FeB₄中，常压下界面熔体因自由能曲面凹陷而失稳，施加压力可恢复其稳定性，与高压合成实验边界一致。；创新点：将界面熔体稳定性（可通过结构因子发散评估）作为固态合成可行性的热力学筛选描述符，为AI辅助材料发现提供新的筛选判据，超越了仅依赖形成能凸包的热力学稳定性判据。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于精细调优的机器学习原子间势的熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟，分析浓度-浓度结构因子和自由能曲面，并结合低压与高压条件下的合成实验边界进行对比验证。

papers.title: Thermal Transport in SiC with Intrinsic Defects and Mg Transmutation Products
papers.abstract: Silicon carbide is a leading candidate material for advanced nuclear energy systems, but irradiation-induced defects and transmutation products can severely degrade its thermal conductivity. In fusion environments, Mg is predicted to be a major solid transmutant in SiC, yet it is not well understood how different Mg-related defects affect phonon transport. Here, we develop a machine-learning interatomic potential, MLIP4SiC-Mg, for 3C-SiC containing intrinsic point defects, Mg-related defects, and Mg-defect complexes. The potential is trained on a large DFT dataset and reproduces DFT energies, forces, equation-of-state behavior, phonon dispersions, and lattice thermal conductivities with near-DFT accuracy. Combined with Green-Kubo molecular dynamics, force-error correction, and a resistance-based treatment for dilute defective systems, MLIP4SiC-Mg enables quantitative thermal-conductivity calculations in large defective supercells. The corrected thermal conductivity of pristine 3C-SiC is 421 W/(mK) at 300 K, in good agreement with available experimental data. All defects considered strongly reduce thermal conductivity, but their scattering strengths are highly configuration dependent. V_C and Mg_TC act as strong phonon scatterers, whereas isolated Mg_Si is comparatively weak. Residual thermal resistivity analysis shows that defect-induced thermal resistance is not strictly linear with concentration and should be treated as an effective temperature- and concentration-dependent scattering metric. Mg_Si-V_C clustering enhances scattering relative to isolated Mg_Si, but reduces the total excess resistance relative to spatially separated Mg_Si and V_C defects. These results clarify the configuration-dependent role of Mg transmutation in irradiation-degraded SiC and provide an atomistic framework for quantifying defect-controlled heat transport in nuclear ceramics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：开发机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）、结合DFT数据集、Green-Kubo分子动力学模拟。；研究对象：3C-SiC（碳化硅）中的本征缺陷、Mg嬗变产物及其相关缺陷对热输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有缺陷均强烈降低SiC的热导率，但散射强度高度依赖于缺陷构型：V_C（碳空位）和Mg_TC（Mg占据C位）是强声子散射体，而孤立Mg_Si（Mg占据Si位）散射较弱；Mg_Si-V_C团簇相比孤立Mg_Si增强散射，但相比空间分离的Mg_Si和V_C缺陷，总过剩热阻反而降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有缺陷均强烈降低SiC的热导率，但散射强度高度依赖于缺陷构型：V_C（碳空位）和Mg_TC（Mg占据C位）是强声子散射体，而孤立Mg_Si（Mg占据Si位）散射较弱；Mg_Si-V_C团簇相比孤立Mg_Si增强散射，但相比空间分离的Mg_Si和V_C缺陷，总过剩热阻反而降低。；创新点：首次系统研究了Mg嬗变产物在SiC中不同构型缺陷（包括孤立缺陷和缺陷团簇）对声子输运的构型依赖性影响，并揭示了缺陷诱导热阻的非线性浓度依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 开发了机器学习原子间势MLIP4SiC-Mg，基于大规模DFT数据集训练，结合Green-Kubo分子动力学、力误差校正（force-error correction）以及针对稀缺陷体系的基于电阻的处理方法（resistance-based treatment），实现大尺寸缺陷超胞中的定量热导率计算。

papers.title: Isometrization of Tensor Network States via Gauge Propagation
papers.abstract: We introduce a gauge-propagation approach for approximately converting generic tensor-network states into an isometric tensor-network state form with a prescribed orthogonality center. In one dimension, this propagation is exact because the non-isometric factor produced by a QR or singular-value decomposition is supported on a single virtual bond. In higher-dimensional networks, however, a local step can have several outgoing directions, and the residual factor is generally not separable into independent single-bond contributions. We address this local obstruction by approximating a local tensor, or a contracted local cluster, by structured terms consisting of an isometric factor multiplied by a tensor product of output-leg factors. The isometric factor is retained at the current site or cluster, while the output-leg factors are absorbed into neighboring tensors along the propagation directions. This construction provides a local truncation criterion for gauge propagation and a practical route to refinement by increasing the number of retained terms or enlarging the local cluster. Benchmarks on random tensors and on the loop-gas tensor representation of the Kitaev spin liquid show that this refinement reduces both local residuals and accumulated propagation errors. For the loop-gas tensor, two structured terms reduce the local residual to numerical precision, and enlarging the local object from 2-in-2-out to 4-in-2-out and 6-in-2-out clusters lowers both local truncation errors and accumulated errors in finite honeycomb gauge propagation. These results identify propagation-compatible local decomposition as a useful building block for approximate isometrization and as a potential initializer or preconditioner for variational isoTNS algorithms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了新的数值方法（gauge-propagation approach），并进行了数值基准测试（benchmarks on random tensors and on the loop-gas tensor representation）。；研究对象：张量网络态（tensor-network states），特别是将其转化为等距张量网络态（isometric tensor-network state form）的通用方法。具体测试体系包括随机张量和Kitaev自旋液体的环气张量表示（loop-gas tensor representation）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种通过规范传播（gauge propagation）将通用张量网络态近似转化为具有指定正交中心的等距张量网络态的方法，并通过保留多个结构项或扩大局域团簇尺寸来降低截断误差和累积传播误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种通过规范传播（gauge propagation）将通用张量网络态近似转化为具有指定正交中心的等距张量网络态的方法，并通过保留多个结构项或扩大局域团簇尺寸来降低截断误差和累积传播误差。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的明确对比，但该方法的核心创新在于：针对高维张量网络中局域步骤存在多个输出方向时残差因子不可分离的困难，提出了通过结构化近似和局域团簇扩大的实用截断方案，并展示了其作为变分等距张量网络态算法初始化或预条件子的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 规范传播方法：在局域步骤中，将局域张量或收缩后的局域团簇近似分解为等距因子与输出支路因子张量积的结构化项，等距因子保留在当前位点，输出支路因子沿传播方向吸收到相邻张量中。通过QR分解或奇异值分解处理非等距因子，并引入局域截断准则。在随机张量和Kitaev自旋液体的环气张量上进行了数值基准测试。

papers.title: Strain-tuned orbital-dependent electronic correlations in FeTe thin films
papers.abstract: Iron chalcogenides exhibit rich phenomena which are governed by orbital-dependent electronic interactions and strong electronic correlation. In particular, many studies have explored orbital selectivity in FeTe through Se doping. Here, applying tensile strain to thin films allows us to precisely control the system without other impurities that may arise from chemical doping to investigate the emergent behaviors in FeTe. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we observe a spectral weight transfer between $d_{\rm xy}$ and $d_{\rm z^{2}}$ orbitals, evidence of an orbital-selective Mott phase (OSMP). Beyond OSMP, we reveal hitherto unobserved strain-induced effects, distinct from chemical doping. The evolution of $d_{\rm xz}$ orbital demonstrates how electron hopping mechanism plays an important role in defining the electronic properties of the system. Our findings highlight a direct correlation between epitaxial strain and the evolution of electronic structures in FeTe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy”（角分辨光电子能谱）、“thin films”（薄膜）、“tensile strain”（拉伸应变）。；研究对象：FeTe薄膜中的轨道依赖电子关联效应，特别是通过外延应变调控的轨道选择性莫特相（OSMP）及电子结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在FeTe薄膜中施加拉伸应变，观测到d_xy与d_z²轨道之间的谱权重转移，证实了轨道选择性莫特相的存在；并发现了与化学掺杂不同的、此前未被观测到的应变诱导效应，其中d_xz轨道的演化揭示了电子跳跃机制对电子性质的关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在FeTe薄膜中施加拉伸应变，观测到d_xy与d_z²轨道之间的谱权重转移，证实了轨道选择性莫特相的存在；并发现了与化学掺杂不同的、此前未被观测到的应变诱导效应，其中d_xz轨道的演化揭示了电子跳跃机制对电子性质的关键作用。；创新点：通过纯应变调控（而非化学掺杂）精确研究FeTe中的轨道选择性电子关联，发现了与化学掺杂不同的新应变诱导效应，并揭示了d_xz轨道中电子跳跃机制对电子性质的重要影响。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：分子束外延（MBE）生长FeTe薄膜，施加外延拉伸应变；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量电子结构。

papers.title: Hierarchical Granular Metamaterials
papers.abstract: Granular materials dissipate energy efficiently through intergranular interactions, yet their disordered, dense nature precludes precise control and integration into lightweight systems. Architected materials offer tunable mechanical responses at low densities but tend to localize stress, limiting dissipation efficiency. Here, we introduce hierarchical granular metamaterials that reconcile these trade-offs through three levels of design: lightweight architected grains engineered with hollow elliptical inclusions, crystal-inspired grain packings, and functional gradients and defects within grain tessellations. These metamaterials exhibit simultaneous increases in impact energy absorption per unit mass and reductions in transmitted peak force at low densities, outperforming conventional architected materials. In situ nanomechanical experiments and nonlinear computational models reveal that enhanced lateral grain expansion drives recruitment of neighboring grains, amplifying plastic and frictional dissipation. Multiscale impact experiments confirm that these mechanisms persist across length scales, constituent materials, and dimensionalities. Beyond mechanical performance, we demonstrate that spatially programmable inter-grain contact networks enable deterministic routing of deformation, which extends to electrical transport pathways independently of packing geometry. By combining granular principles with architected material design, this work establishes a paradigm for multifunctional metamaterials whose contact topology, mechanical response, and transport properties can be programmed independently.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。关键词：in situ nanomechanical experiments、nonlinear computational models、multiscale impact experiments。；研究对象：层级颗粒超材料（hierarchical granular metamaterials），具体为具有空心椭圆内含物的轻质架构颗粒、类晶体颗粒堆积以及功能梯度与缺陷的颗粒镶嵌结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该层级颗粒超材料在低密度下同时实现了单位质量冲击能量吸收的提升和传递峰值力的降低，性能优于传统架构材料；其可编程的颗粒间接触网络能独立于堆积几何形状实现变形路径的确定性引导，并扩展至电输运路径调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该层级颗粒超材料在低密度下同时实现了单位质量冲击能量吸收的提升和传递峰值力的降低，性能优于传统架构材料；其可编程的颗粒间接触网络能独立于堆积几何形状实现变形路径的确定性引导，并扩展至电输运路径调控。；创新点：将颗粒材料的高效耗能原理与架构材料的轻质可设计性相结合，通过三个层级（颗粒内结构、颗粒堆积、颗粒镶嵌）的设计协同解决了传统材料中轻质与耗能难以兼得的矛盾，并实现了接触拓扑、力学响应和输运性质的独立编程。
papers.method_zh: 原位纳米力学实验、非线性计算模型、多尺度冲击实验（涵盖不同长度尺度、组成材料和维度）。

papers.title: Modulating radiative heat and momentum transfer via the thermal Purcell effect
papers.abstract: The thermal Purcell effect describes the modification of the local density of states of the fluctuating electromagnetic field induced by a Fabry-Pérot cavity, leading to the enhancement or suppression of radiative transport quantities. Using fluctuational electrodynamics, we investigate nonequilibrium radiative heat, linear-momentum, and angular-momentum exchange between a magneto-optic nanoparticle and a Fabry-Pérot cavity. Analytical expressions for the spectral densities reveal that geometric confinement modifies the electromagnetic local density of states, producing distinct behaviors for different transport quantities. Specifically, sub-wavelength confinement enhances radiative heat and angular-momentum transfer, but suppresses the lateral force. Additionally, interference between cavity modes causes all transfer quantities to oscillate spatially with particle position. At the cavity center, mirror symmetry enforces a parity decomposition of electromagnetic fluctuations resulting in a vanishing lateral force, whereas heat transfer and torque remain finite through combined even and odd modal contributions. These results demonstrate that cavity engineering provides selective control over nanoscale energy and momentum transfer via structured electromagnetic fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fluctuational electrodynamics（涨落电动力学）、analytical expressions（解析表达式）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：磁光纳米颗粒与法布里-珀罗腔之间的非平衡辐射热传递、线动量传递和角动量传递现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过法布里-珀罗腔的几何约束，可以增强辐射热和角动量传递，但抑制横向力；腔模干涉导致所有传递量随粒子位置空间振荡，且在腔中心处横向力因镜像对称性而消失，而热传递和扭矩仍保持有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过法布里-珀罗腔的几何约束，可以增强辐射热和角动量传递，但抑制横向力；腔模干涉导致所有传递量随粒子位置空间振荡，且在腔中心处横向力因镜像对称性而消失，而热传递和扭矩仍保持有限。；创新点：揭示了热珀塞尔效应（thermal Purcell effect）对辐射热、线动量和角动量传递的差异化调控能力，特别是通过腔工程实现选择性控制纳米尺度能量与动量传递。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于涨落电动力学（fluctuational electrodynamics）理论，推导了辐射热、线动量和角动量传递的谱密度解析表达式，分析了电磁局域态密度（local density of states）的修正效应。

papers.title: Higher-Order Topological Phase Transitions in Continuous Hyperelastic Manifolds: From Surface Wrinkles to Zero-Energy Corner States
papers.abstract: Higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs) have revolutionized our understanding of wave localization, extending the bulk-boundary correspondence to lower-dimensional hinges and corners. Thus far, the realization of mechanical HOTIs has relied exclusively on discretely engineered metamaterials or periodic phononic lattices. Here, we report a fundamental paradigm shift by demonstrating that continuous, homogeneous hyperelastic manifolds undergoing finite multiaxial deformations naturally harbor intrinsic higher-order topological phases. By extending the generalized Stroh-Lie impedance formalism into a fully coupled 3D finite-strain framework, we map the highly nonlinear orthotropic geometric frustration onto a four-band effective Dirac Hamiltonian spanned by Clifford $Γ$-matrices. We reveal that macroscopic orthogonal stretches act precisely as competing Dirac mass terms, driving the continuous spatial transitions of topological domain walls and triggering a breakdown of $C_{4v}$ spatial symmetry. Remarkably, we analytically prove that beyond classical 2D surface wrinkling (1st-order topology), concurrent multiaxial extreme compression unconditionally triggers the emergence of 1D hinge states (2nd-order) and completely localized 0D zero-energy corner states (3rd-order). We further extend this static bifurcation framework into the elastodynamic regime, proving the existence of mid-gap localized vibrational modes. The theoretically derived topological phase diagram, nested Wilson loops, and fractional corner charges are comprehensively verified. Finally, we propose a concrete experimental realization using electro-active dielectric elastomers, enabling the dynamic programming of 0D topological singularities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算与实验方案设计）。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了理论框架（广义Stroh-Lie阻抗形式、有效狄拉克哈密顿量）、数值验证（拓扑相图、嵌套Wilson loop、分数角电荷），并提出了具体的实验实现方案（电活性介电弹性体）。；研究对象：连续、均匀的超弹性流形（hyperelastic manifolds）在有限多轴变形下的高阶拓扑相变，具体涉及从表面褶皱到零能角态的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了连续、均匀的超弹性体在有限多轴压缩下，可以自然地承载内禀的高阶拓扑相，包括一维铰链态（二阶）和完全局域的零维零能角态（三阶），从而将高阶拓扑绝缘体的概念从离散超材料拓展至连续介质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了连续、均匀的超弹性体在有限多轴压缩下，可以自然地承载内禀的高阶拓扑相，包括一维铰链态（二阶）和完全局域的零维零能角态（三阶），从而将高阶拓扑绝缘体的概念从离散超材料拓展至连续介质。；创新点：首次在连续、均匀的超弹性流形中证明了内禀的高阶拓扑相，打破了此前机械高阶拓扑绝缘体必须依赖离散工程超材料或周期性声子晶体的范式。摘要未突出说明与具体已有离散模型在拓扑相图细节上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将广义Stroh-Lie阻抗形式扩展到完全耦合的三维有限应变框架，将非线性正交各向异性几何失稳映射到由Clifford Γ矩阵张成的四带有效狄拉克哈密顿量。数值验证：通过拓扑相图、嵌套Wilson loop和分数角电荷进行验证。实验方案：提出使用电活性介电弹性体实现动态可编程的零维拓扑奇点。

papers.title: Selectivity in tip-induced skeletal editing via heteroatom substitution
papers.abstract: Skeletal editing enables precise structural modifications of molecules at late stages of a synthetic sequence, with applications in drug discovery and materials science. We recently demonstrated skeletal editing on the single-molecule scale. Voltage pulses applied by the tip of a scanning probe microscope to an oxygen-containing seven-membered heterocycle led to both oxygen deletion and ring-contraction rearrangement reactions. An open question is whether selective skeletal editing of a heterocyclic core can be achieved by an appropriate choice of the heteroatom. Here, we show that tip-induced reactions of an analogous sulfur-containing seven-membered ring results in sulfur deletion in virtually all cases. Our results demonstrate that the combination of tip-induced chemistry and heteroatom selection in the molecular design is a powerful strategy for single-molecule skeletal editing, with the potential to enable diverse structural transformations of heterocyclic frameworks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：tip-induced reactions、scanning probe microscope、single-molecule scale。；研究对象：含硫七元杂环分子在单分子尺度下的针尖诱导骨架编辑反应，具体为硫原子选择性脱除反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过针尖施加电压脉冲，含硫七元杂环分子几乎全部发生硫原子脱除反应，实现了高选择性的单分子骨架编辑，而此前含氧类似物则同时发生氧脱除和环收缩重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过针尖施加电压脉冲，含硫七元杂环分子几乎全部发生硫原子脱除反应，实现了高选择性的单分子骨架编辑，而此前含氧类似物则同时发生氧脱除和环收缩重排。；创新点：首次证明通过选择杂原子（硫替代氧）可以实现针尖诱导单分子骨架编辑的高选择性，即硫脱除反应占绝对主导，而氧类似物则反应路径多样。
papers.method_zh: 扫描探针显微镜（SPM）针尖施加电压脉冲，诱导单分子反应，并结合分子设计（选择不同杂原子）进行对比研究。

papers.title: High-Resolution Probing of Molecular Junctions: Vibrational Fingerprinting and Parameter Extraction via Current Noise Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: The precise realization of molecular electronic devices requires a comprehensive understanding of charge transport mechanisms and the specific interplay between electronic and nuclear degrees of freedom. While average current measurements (I-V characteristics) and conventional Inelastic Electron Tunneling Spectroscopy (IETS) offer valuable insights, they are fundamentally limited by temperature-dependent line-width broadening. This study presents a high-resolution spectroscopic methodology utilizing suspended-wire molecular junctions (SWMJs) based on self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) of 1-decanethiol (C10) and 1,1',4',1''-terphenyl-4-thiol (TPT). By systematically probing the voltage-dependent current noise ($ΔI$), we demonstrate that electronic noise spectroscopy circumvents thermal degradation by probing transition rates between vibrational manifolds rather than simple additions of conductance channels, which enables sub-thermal feature mapping. Leveraging a fast-convolution-based Landauer-Büttiker transport model fitted to experimental data, we map complex vibrational manifolds, including high-energy overtones. This allows for the direct extraction of crucial nanoscale molecular parameters, including mode energies, anharmonicities ($x_e$), dissociation energies ($D_e$), and local environment reorganization energies ($E_r$). These parameter-dense noise signatures act as a unique molecular fingerprint, establishing noise spectroscopy as a highly sensitive platform for chemical sensing and discrimination in advanced quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论模型拟合）。判断依据：关键词“suspended-wire molecular junctions (SWMJs)”、“systematically probing the voltage-dependent current noise”、“fitted to experimental data”。；研究对象：基于自组装单分子层（SAMs）的分子结，具体为1-癸硫醇（C10）和1,1',4',1''-三联苯-4-硫醇（TPT）分子结中的电荷输运与振动耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量电压依赖的电流噪声（ΔI），实现了对分子结振动谱的亚热力学极限高分辨率探测，并从中直接提取了分子振动模式能量、非谐性、解离能及局域环境重组能等关键纳米尺度参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量电压依赖的电流噪声（ΔI），实现了对分子结振动谱的亚热力学极限高分辨率探测，并从中直接提取了分子振动模式能量、非谐性、解离能及局域环境重组能等关键纳米尺度参数。；创新点：提出利用电子噪声谱学替代传统非弹性电子隧穿谱（IETS），通过探测振动能级间的跃迁速率而非电导通道的简单叠加，有效规避了温度依赖的谱线展宽，实现了亚热力学尺度的特征映射，并将噪声信号作为独特的分子指纹用于化学传感与识别。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用悬空线分子结（SWMJs）技术构建自组装单分子层，并系统测量其电压依赖的电流噪声谱。理论上，利用基于快速卷积的Landauer-Büttiker输运模型对实验数据进行拟合，以映射复杂的振动流形（包括高能泛频振动）。

papers.title: Pyroelectric, electrocaloric and thermoelectric properties of core-shell HfxZr1-xO2 nanoparticles: theory and experiment
papers.abstract: Nanosized hafnia-zirconia (HfxZr1-xO2) in the form of thin films, multilayers, and nanoparticles are indispensable CMOS-compatible ferroelectric materials for advanced electronic memories and logic devices. Using the Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire free energy functional with trilinear and biquadratic couplings of polar, nonpolar, and antipolar order parameters, we analyze the pyroelectric and electrocaloric properties of an ensemble of spherical core-shell HfxZr1-xO2 nanoparticles. Complementary to theoretical calculations, we experimentally measure the temperature dependence of the electric charge accumulated in pressed powders consisting of oxygen-deficient Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 nanoparticles with an average size of 7 nm. The observed temperature-dependent behavior of the accumulated charge and its derivative with respect to temperature are in qualitative agreement with the dependences of polarization and pyroelectric coefficient calculated for the ensemble of densely packed spherical core-shell HfxZr1-xO2 nanoparticles. Thus, these results can open the way for creation of CMOS-compatible HfxZr1-xO2 nanoparticles for pyroelectric, electrocaloric, and thermoelectric applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论与实验结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“using the Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire free energy functional...we analyze”（理论计算）和“we experimentally measure the temperature dependence of the electric charge”（实验测量）。；研究对象：核壳结构HfxZr1-xO2纳米颗粒的焦热电、电卡和热电性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验测量的氧缺陷Hf0.5Zr0.5O2纳米颗粒（平均尺寸7 nm）压粉体中累积电荷随温度的变化及其温度导数，与理论计算得到的密集堆积球形核壳HfxZr1-xO2纳米颗粒的极化强度和焦热电系数的温度依赖关系定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验测量的氧缺陷Hf0.5Zr0.5O2纳米颗粒（平均尺寸7 nm）压粉体中累积电荷随温度的变化及其温度导数，与理论计算得到的密集堆积球形核壳HfxZr1-xO2纳米颗粒的极化强度和焦热电系数的温度依赖关系定性一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：采用包含极性、非极性和反极性序参量的三线性及双二次耦合的Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire自由能泛函，分析球形核壳HfxZr1-xO2纳米颗粒系综的性质。实验方面：测量平均尺寸7 nm的氧缺陷Hf0.5Zr0.5O2纳米颗粒压粉体中累积电荷随温度的变化。

papers.title: Neural Polaron: Learning Quasiparticle Operators in Quantum Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: Understanding dynamical properties of quantum many-body systems remains a central challenge because excitations generally require information beyond a ground-state wave function. Here we introduce a neural polaron ansatz that represents quasiparticle excitations by neural many-body operators acting on a correlated ground state. Instead of learning an independent excited-state wave function, the method parameterizes a local dressing operator through a compact neural head defined on the feature map of a pretrained ground-state network. This operator-based construction builds in translation symmetry, momentum resolution, and quasiparticle locality, while separating ground-state correlations from excitation-specific dressing. We benchmark the method on the square-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model, where it accurately reproduces magnon dispersions and spectral weights over a broad range of frustration. In particular, it captures nontrivial many-body features including the $(π,0)$ anomaly and its progressive softening with increasing $J_2/J_1$. These results establish neural operators as a physically transparent route for extending neural quantum states from ground-state properties to dynamical response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：关键词“neural polaron ansatz”、“neural many-body operators”、“pretrained ground-state network”、“benchmark”。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的准粒子激发，具体以正方晶格$J_1$-$J_2$海森堡模型为基准体系，研究其磁振子（magnon）色散和谱权重。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“神经极化子”方法，通过神经网络算符作用于关联基态来表征准粒子激发，能够准确复现$J_1$-$J_2$海森堡模型在宽泛阻挫范围内的磁振子色散和谱权重，并捕捉到$(π,0)$反常及其随$J_2/J_1$增大而逐渐软化的非平庸多体特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“神经极化子”方法，通过神经网络算符作用于关联基态来表征准粒子激发，能够准确复现$J_1$-$J_2$海森堡模型在宽泛阻挫范围内的磁振子色散和谱权重，并捕捉到$(π,0)$反常及其随$J_2/J_1$增大而逐渐软化的非平庸多体特征。；创新点：将准粒子激发表示为神经网络算符作用于基态，而非独立学习激发态波函数，从而在保持物理透明性（对称性、动量、局域性）的同时，将神经量子态从基态性质拓展至动力学响应。
papers.method_zh: 采用“神经极化子”变分拟设：利用预训练基态网络的特征图，通过一个紧凑的神经“头部”（neural head）参数化局域缀饰算符（dressing operator），从而构建激发态算符。该方法内建平移对称性、动量分辨率和准粒子局域性，并将基态关联与激发缀饰分离。

papers.title: Hysteresis-Driven Radiative Mpemba Effect in Phase-Change Nanostructures
papers.abstract: The Mpemba effect states that initially hotter systems cool faster than colder ones. While known in convective, conductive, and quantum systems, its radiative analogue is unexplored. Here, this anomaly is realized via phase-change hysteresis of a VO$_2$ nanoparticle near a SiC substrate. After analytically deriving an onset condition, the phase space is mapped. Crucially, latent heat acts as a thermal buffer enabling both ordinary and inverse effects. Near-field coupling governs the relaxation time and enables a passive effect where memory is stored externally via substrate reflection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytically deriving、phase space mapped、analytical onset condition）；研究对象：基于VO₂纳米颗粒相变滞后的辐射型Mpemba效应，具体体系为靠近SiC衬底的VO₂纳米颗粒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过VO₂的相变滞后效应，实现了辐射传热中的Mpemba效应（初始较热系统比初始较冷系统冷却更快），并发现潜热作为热缓冲层可同时实现普通和反向Mpemba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过VO₂的相变滞后效应，实现了辐射传热中的Mpemba效应（初始较热系统比初始较冷系统冷却更快），并发现潜热作为热缓冲层可同时实现普通和反向Mpemba效应。；创新点：首次在辐射传热体系中实现Mpemba效应，此前该效应仅在对流、传导和量子系统中被研究。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导了效应发生的起始条件，并系统映射了相空间；分析了近场耦合对弛豫时间的影响，以及通过衬底反射实现外部存储记忆的被动效应。

papers.title: Formation and dynamics of self-bound droplets in dipolar molecular condensate
papers.abstract: Recent advances in the work with ultracold condensates of polar molecules have enabled the realization of highly tunable self-bound quantum droplets (QDs), with the help of dual microwave fields dressig the dipole-dipole interactions (DDIs) It has been reported that symmetry properties and the equilibrium phase diagram of such QDs can be controlled by parameters of the two microwave fields. However, the effect of these fields on the formation and dynamics of the QD has not yet been systematically explored. Here we address self-bound QDs in a regime dominated by non-axisymmetric DDIs and governed by the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation with the Lee-Huang-Yang corrections. Within this framework, we identify the existence region of the self-bound QDs and characterize their chemical potential, total energy, effective volume, peak density, and geometric anisotropy. The results reveal a pronounced nonmonotonous dependence on the non-axisymmetric DDI strength, whereas the increase of the number of particles in the condensate leads to tighter bound and more anisotropic QDs. Furthermore, reducing the s-wave scattering length drives a transition from stable self-bound states to the collapse. Collisions between QDs moving along different directions reveal a strong directional dependence, with outcomes ranging from quasi-elastic rebound and merger to fragmentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation（扩展的Gross-Pitaevskii方程）、Lee-Huang-Yang corrections（Lee-Huang-Yang修正）、数值求解。；研究对象：极性分子超冷凝聚体中自束缚量子液滴（self-bound quantum droplets, QDs）的形成与动力学，特别是非轴对称偶极-偶极相互作用（DDIs）主导下的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自束缚量子液滴的存在区域、化学势、总能量、有效体积、峰值密度和几何各向异性对非轴对称DDI强度呈现显著的非单调依赖；增加凝聚体粒子数使液滴更紧致、更各向异性；减小s波散射长度可导致从稳定自束缚态到坍缩的转变；不同方向运动的液滴碰撞表现出强方向依赖性，结果包括准弹性反弹、合并和碎裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自束缚量子液滴的存在区域、化学势、总能量、有效体积、峰值密度和几何各向异性对非轴对称DDI强度呈现显著的非单调依赖；增加凝聚体粒子数使液滴更紧致、更各向异性；减小s波散射长度可导致从稳定自束缚态到坍缩的转变；不同方向运动的液滴碰撞表现出强方向依赖性，结果包括准弹性反弹、合并和碎裂。；创新点：系统探索了双微波场调控下非轴对称偶极-偶极相互作用对自束缚量子液滴形成与动力学的影响，揭示了非轴对称DDI强度与液滴性质之间的非单调关系，以及碰撞过程的方向依赖性。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含Lee-Huang-Yang修正的扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程（eGPE）进行理论建模与数值求解，通过双微波场调控偶极-偶极相互作用的对称性。

papers.title: Quantum Metric Bound State of Light
papers.abstract: The spatial confinement of defect-induced bound states is conventionally governed by the effective mass in dispersive bands. More recently, Compact Localized States (CLSs) arising from exact destructive interference have been utilized to achieve confinement in flat bands. However, CLSs rely on pristine lattice symmetries and fine-tuned defect profiles. The introduction of a generic local impurity inevitably breaks these strict phase-matching conditions, resulting in extensive bound states whose fundamental length scale has remained an open question. Here, we establish a third regime of confinement: the quantum metric bound state. We provide a rigorous mathematical proof demonstrating that in the absence of kinetic energy and CLS protection, the exponential decay length of these states is lower-bounded by the quantum metric of the unperturbed flat band. We demonstrate the tightness of this geometric limit by constructing a family of highly tunable flat-band generators, and we verify its universality across diverse realistic architectures. Ultimately, this classification establishes the independently measurable quantum metric as a predictive design principle for engineering confined modes in synthetic wave platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：rigorous mathematical proof、establish、classification。；研究对象：平带（flat band）中由局域杂质诱导的束缚态（bound state）的局域化机制，特别是量子度量（quantum metric）对束缚态衰减长度的约束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无动能项且无紧致局域态（CLS）保护的情况下，平带中杂质束缚态的指数衰减长度存在一个由未扰动平带量子度量决定的下界，从而确立了一种新的束缚态局域化机制——量子度量束缚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无动能项且无紧致局域态（CLS）保护的情况下，平带中杂质束缚态的指数衰减长度存在一个由未扰动平带量子度量决定的下界，从而确立了一种新的束缚态局域化机制——量子度量束缚态。；创新点：首次从理论上证明并分类了平带中杂质束缚态局域化长度的几何下界，将量子度量确立为一种独立可测量的、可预测的设计原理，区别于传统的有效质量局域化和紧致局域态（CLS）干涉局域化。
papers.method_zh: 严格的数学证明（rigorous mathematical proof），结合构建高度可调平带生成器（family of highly tunable flat-band generators）来验证下界的紧致性，并在多种现实架构中检验其普适性。

papers.title: Perturbative Renormalization and Universality Diagram for Long-Range Quantum Criticality
papers.abstract: Experimental progress in quantum simulators highlights the role of long-range (LR) interactions in reshaping quantum criticality and stabilizing exotic phases beyond the short-range (SR) paradigm. We study ferromagnetic long-range quantum $O(n)$ models with interactions decaying as $1/r^{d+σ}$ and develop a perturbative renormalization-group expansion around the LR--SR boundary by setting $d=3-ε$ and $σ=2-δ$. In this parametrization, the full interacting LR window $2d/3<σ<2$ becomes $0<δ<2ε/3$, and is therefore perturbatively controlled.
